9-to-5.definition: Giờ làm việc hành chính; công việc toàn thời gian (thường từ 9 giờ sáng đến 5 giờ chiều).
9-to-5.example: I’m tired of the 9-to-5 grind and want a more flexible schedule.

A bad apple.definition: Kẻ xấu trong nhóm; con sâu làm rầu nồi canh.
A bad apple.example: They had to fire him because he was a bad apple disrupting the workplace harmony.

A baker’s dozen.example: I ordered a dozen bagels, but the kind baker gave me a baker’s dozen.

A ballpark figure.definition: Con số ước tính; lượng ước đoán.
A ballpark figure.example: Can you give me a ballpark figure of the total cost?

A bird in the hand is worth two in the b.definition: Có còn hơn không; trân trọng những gì đang có (thay vì theo đuổi những thứ viển vông).
A bird in the hand is worth two in the b.example: You should take the job offer; remember, a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.

A bit/A little bit.example: I’m feeling a bit tired today.

A blessing in disguise.definition: Trong cái rủi có cái may; việc tốt đội lốt việc xấu.
A blessing in disguise.example: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise; it pushed me to start my own business.

A bone to pick.definition: Chuyện cần phải làm rõ; vấn đề cần giải quyết (thường mang tính chất phàn nàn, cãi vã).
A bone to pick.example: I have a bone to pick with you about your comments yesterday.

A breath of fresh air.definition: Làn gió mới; luồng sinh khí mới.
A breath of fresh air.example: Her innovative ideas were a breath of fresh air for the company.

A bunch of.definition: Một mớ; một đống; rất nhiều.
A bunch of.example: There’s a bunch of paperwork on my desk I need to finish.

A chip off the old block.definition: Cha nào con nấy, bản sao của bố/mẹ.
A chip off the old block.example: He’s a chip off the old block – just as stubborn as his father.

A chip on your shoulder.definition: Dễ nổi cáu; ôm hận trong lòng; thái độ hằn học.
A chip on your shoulder.example: He’s always had a chip on his shoulder ever since he got passed over for the promotion.

A day late and a dollar short.definition: Quá muộn màng và không đủ (thường dùng khi sự giúp đỡ hoặc hành động đã quá muộn để xoay chuyển tình thế).
A day late and a dollar short.example: Her apology felt a day late and a dollar short after the damage was already done.

A dime a dozen.definition: Rẻ như bèo; đồ bỏ đi; nhiều vô kể.
A dime a dozen.example: Cheap souvenirs are a dime a dozen at the tourist market.

A doozy.definition: Chuyện kinh khủng; thứ phi thường; việc rất khó khăn.
A doozy.example: That test was a real doozy — one of the hardest I’ve ever taken.

A doubting Thomas.definition: Kẻ đa nghi; người không dễ tin vào người khác.
A doubting Thomas.example: He’s such a doubting Thomas, always needing proof before he believes anything we say.

a drop in the bucket.definition: Hạt muối bỏ biển, chả thấm vào đâu.
a drop in the bucket.example: The charity event raised $500, but it's just a drop in the bucket compared to what's needed.

a drop in the ocean.definition: Giọt nước giữa biển khơi, hạt cát trong sa mạc; số lượng quá ít ỏi.
a drop in the ocean.example: A thousand dollars is just a drop in the ocean compared to the millions needed for the hospital.

A far cry from (something).definition: Khác xa với; một trời một vực.
A far cry from (something).example: Living in the city is a far cry from living in the countryside.

a feather in one's cap.definition: Một thành tựu đáng tự hào, niềm hãnh diện.
a feather in one's cap.example: Winning the championship was a real feather in his cap.

A fifth wheel.definition: Người thừa; kỳ đà cản mũi.
A fifth wheel.example: Whenever my friends go out on dates, I always feel like a fifth wheel.

A flash in the pan.definition: Hiện tượng sớm nở tối tàn; thành công chớp nhoáng.
A flash in the pan.example: His performance was impressive, but it turned out to be just a flash in the pan.

A fool and his money are easily parted.definition: Kẻ ngốc không biết giữ tiền; tiêu tiền như nước.
A fool and his money are easily parted.example: He spent all his savings on lottery tickets. A fool and his money are easily parted.

A for effort.definition: Điểm 10 cho sự nỗ lực; đáng khen vì đã cố gắng.
A for effort.example: The project didn’t work out as planned, but the team deserves an A for effort.

A fork in the road.definition: Ngã rẽ cuộc đời; bước ngoặt mang tính quyết định.
A fork in the road.example: When the company restructured, she found herself at a fork in the road in her professional life.

a friend in need is a friend indeed.definition: Bạn lúc hoạn nạn mới là bạn chân tình; gian nan mới tỏ mặt bạn bè.
a friend in need is a friend indeed.example: She stood by me when I lost my job, proving that a friend in need is a friend indeed.

A good Samaritan.definition: Người tốt bụng thiện nguyện; người hay giúp đỡ người khác.
A good Samaritan.example: A good Samaritan reached out to help the elderly man who had fallen on the sidewalk.

A hang-up.definition: Mặc cảm tâm lý; nỗi ám ảnh; sự lo âu vô cớ.
A hang-up.example: She has a real hang-up about speaking in public.

A hard nut to crack.definition: Bài toán khó; vấn đề hóc búa; người khó nhằn.
A hard nut to crack.example: The math problem was a hard nut to crack, but she finally solved it.

a heart of gold.definition: Trái tim nhân hậu, tấm lòng vàng.
a heart of gold.example: Grandmother has a heart of gold and is always helping the needy in our town.

A hot potato.definition: Củ khoai lang nóng; chủ đề nhạy cảm; vấn đề nan giải không ai muốn giải quyết.
A hot potato.example: The issue of rising taxes has become a hot potato for the government.

A kickback.definition: Tiền hoa hồng bất chính; tiền hối lộ.
A kickback.example: The contractor was arrested for offering a kickback to secure the project.

A level playing field.example: We need to ensure a level playing field for all businesses, big and small.

A little bird told me.definition: Có người tiết lộ cho tôi; nghe phong thanh rằng.
A little bird told me.example: A little bird told me you’re getting a promotion soon.

A little learning is a dangerous thing.definition: Nửa cái bánh mì vẫn là bánh mì, nhưng nửa sự thật thì không phải là sự thật; biết nửa vời rất nguy hiểm.
A little learning is a dangerous thing.example: He tried to fix the car himself, but a little learning is a dangerous thing — now it’s in worse condition.

A long face.definition: Mặt mày ủ rũ, buồn thiu.
A long face.example: Why the long face? Did something bad happen?

A loose cannon.definition: Kẻ bốc đồng, người khó lường dễ gây họa.
A loose cannon.example: He's a loose cannon and often makes impulsive decisions that get the company in trouble.

A lucky break.definition: Vận may bất ngờ, cơ hội may mắn.
A lucky break.example: After years of hard work, he finally got a lucky break in his career.

A lucky dog.definition: Người chó ngáp phải ruồi, kẻ may mắn.
A lucky dog.example: He won the lottery again! What a lucky dog!

A memory like a sieve.definition: Trí nhớ cá vàng; não cá vàng; hay quên.
A memory like a sieve.example: My mom has a memory like a sieve and keeps forgetting where she put her keys.

A penny for your thoughts.definition: Bạn đang nghĩ gì vậy? (dùng để hỏi khi thấy ai đó đang mải suy nghĩ).
A penny for your thoughts.example: You’ve been awfully quiet. A penny for your thoughts?

A penny saved is a penny earned.definition: Tích tiểu thành đại; tiết kiệm một đồng cũng bằng kiếm được một đồng.
A penny saved is a penny earned.example: You don’t need that expensive gadget. Remember: A penny saved is a penny earned.

A perfect storm.definition: Cơn bão hoàn hảo; tình huống tồi tệ nhất có thể xảy ra (do nhiều yếu tố bất lợi cùng lúc).
A perfect storm.example: The company’s financial issues, combined with the economic downturn, created a perfect storm.

A picture is worth a thousand words.definition: Một bức ảnh bằng ngàn lời nói; trăm nghe không bằng một thấy.
A picture is worth a thousand words.example: She showed us the photos from her vacation because a picture is worth a thousand words.

A piece of cake.definition: Rất dễ dàng, dễ như ăn kẹo.
A piece of cake.example: Fixing this bike is a piece of cake for me.

A ray of sunshine.definition: Tia hy vọng; nguồn vui; người mang lại niềm vui.
A ray of sunshine.example: Her smile is like a ray of sunshine on a cloudy day.

a red-letter day.definition: Ngày đáng nhớ, ngày trọng đại
a red-letter day.example: The day I got my dream job was a real red-letter day in my life.

A rip-off.definition: Giá cắt cổ; trò bịp bợm móc túi.
A rip-off.example: The tickets to the concert were a total rip-off.

A scorcher.definition: Một ngày nóng đổ lửa, nóng thiêu đốt.
A scorcher.example: We picked the wrong day for a hike — it's a scorcher out there.

A screw loose.definition: Bị chập mạch; hâm hâm dở dở; không bình thường.
A screw loose.example: I think he’s got a screw loose for jumping into that freezing water.

A screwup.definition: Sự thất bại thảm hại; một sai lầm nghiêm trọng (hoặc người hay làm hỏng việc).
A screwup.example: That was a major screwup on his part.

a shoulder to cry on.definition: Chỗ dựa tinh thần, người lắng nghe và an ủi tâm sự.
a shoulder to cry on.example: Whenever she feels overwhelmed by life, she knows her best friend is a shoulder to cry on.

A sledgehammer to crack a nut.definition: Dùng dao mổ trâu để giết gà.
A sledgehammer to crack a nut.example: Bringing in a lawyer for this minor dispute is like using a sledgehammer to crack a nut.

A smart cookie.definition: Người thông minh; người lanh lợi; người tài trí.
A smart cookie.example: She’s a real smart cookie and always finds a way to solve problems.

A snowball effect.definition: Hiệu ứng quả cầu tuyết (sự việc ngày càng lớn dần/nghiêm trọng hơn).
A snowball effect.example: Once the rumor started, it created a snowball effect and spread quickly.

A snowball’s chance in hell.definition: Không có chút cơ hội nào; hy vọng cực kỳ mong manh.
A snowball’s chance in hell.example: He doesn’t have a snowball’s chance in hell of passing that exam without studying.

A stitch in time saves nine.definition: Phòng bệnh hơn chữa bệnh; xử lý sớm tránh phiền phức về sau.
A stitch in time saves nine.example: You should update the software immediately; a stitch in time saves nine.

A stone’s throw.definition: Khoảng cách rất gần; chỉ cách một bước chân.
A stone’s throw.example: The store is just a stone’s throw from my house.

A storm in a teacup.definition: Chuyện bé xé ra to; giông bão trong tách trà.
A storm in a teacup.example: The argument between them was just a storm in a teacup; it was nothing serious.

A storm is brewing.definition: Giông bão sắp ập tới; rắc rối sắp xảy ra.
A storm is brewing.example: You could tell from their argument that a storm is brewing.

A surefire way.definition: Cách chắc ăn nhất; biện pháp nắm chắc phần thắng.
A surefire way.example: Studying hard is a surefire way to improve your grades.

A sweet tooth.definition: Người hảo ngọt; thích ăn đồ ngọt.
A sweet tooth.example: She has a sweet tooth and never skips dessert.

a tall story.definition: chuyện nói khoác, chuyện khó tin
a tall story.example: He told us a tall story about how he once wrestled a bear.

A toss-up.definition: Khả năng 50-50; hên xui; ngang tài ngang sức.
A toss-up.example: Who will win the election? At this point, it’s a toss-up.

A walk in the park.definition: Dễ như ăn bánh, chuyện nhỏ
A walk in the park.example: Fixing the computer was a walk in the park for him.

a wet blanket.definition: Kẻ phá đám, người làm mất hứng (kẻ dội gáo nước lạnh vào cuộc vui).
a wet blanket.example: Do not invite Mark to the beach party; he is such a wet blanket.

A wolf in sheep's clothing.definition: Sói đội lốt cừu, kẻ tâm địa hiểm độc giả dạng người hiền lành
A wolf in sheep's clothing.example: The new CEO was a wolf in sheep's clothing, pretending to care about employees while planning massive layoffs.

Absentminded.definition: Đãng trí; lơ đãng; đểnh đoảng.
Absentminded.example: He’s always so absentminded; he forgot his keys again.

Ace in the hole.definition: Vũ khí bí mật, quân bài tẩy có thể xoay chuyển tình thế vào phút chót.
Ace in the hole.example: His experience in negotiating is his ace in the hole during business meetings.

Ace up the sleeve.definition: Bảo bối giấu kín, vũ khí bí mật.
Ace up the sleeve.example: He thought he had lost, but then he pulled an ace up his sleeve and won the game.

Achilles’ heel.definition: Điểm yếu chí mạng, gót chân Achilles.
Achilles’ heel.example: The software is great, but its security issues are its Achilles’ heel.

Acid test.definition: Phép thử quyết định, bài kiểm tra gắt gao nhất để xác định giá trị thật.
Acid test.example: Facing a crisis is often the acid test of true leadership.

Across the board.definition: Toàn diện, đồng loạt, áp dụng cho mọi người hoặc mọi khía cạnh.
Across the board.example: The company announced a 10% salary increase across the board for all employees.

action speaks louder than words.definition: Hành động có ý nghĩa hơn lời nói; nói đi đôi với làm.
action speaks louder than words.example: He promised to change, but actions speak louder than words.

Actions Speak Louder Than Words.definition: Hành động có giá trị hơn lời nói, nói ít làm nhiều.
Actions Speak Louder Than Words.example: He keeps promising to help, but actions speak louder than words; so far, he hasn’t done anything.

Add fuel to the fire.definition: Thêm dầu vào lửa, đổ thêm dầu vào lửa.
Add fuel to the fire.example: His comments only added fuel to the fire during the argument.

Add insult to injury.definition: Xát muối vào vết thương, đổ thêm dầu vào lửa.
Add insult to injury.example: After losing the game, the team’s captain criticized the players, adding insult to injury.

Against the clock.example: We are working against the clock to meet the project deadline.

Ahead of schedule.definition: Sớm hơn dự kiến, vượt tiến độ.
Ahead of schedule.example: We finished the project ahead of schedule, so we can start the next phase early.

ahead of time.definition: Trước thời hạn, sớm hơn lịch trình.
ahead of time.example: She completed the project two days ahead of time and impressed the client.

All bark and no bite.definition: Khẩu xà tâm phật, thùng rỗng kêu to (chỉ đe dọa chứ không hành động).
All bark and no bite.example: Don’t be afraid of him; he’s all bark and no bite.

All bets are off.definition: Mọi chuyện đều có thể xảy ra, không thể đoán trước được điều gì nữa.
All bets are off.example: Once the CEO resigned, all bets are off regarding the company’s future.

all ears.definition: Lắng tai nghe, chăm chú lắng nghe.
all ears.example: Tell me all about your trip to Paris; I am all ears!

All Greek to me.definition: Như vịt nghe sấm, hoàn toàn không hiểu gì cả.
All Greek to me.example: When they started discussing quantum physics, it was all Greek to me.

All heart.definition: Rất tốt bụng, có trái tim nhân hậu.
All heart.example: She’s all heart, always helping those in need.

all in all.definition: Nhìn chung, tóm lại, sau khi xét mọi khía cạnh.
all in all.example: All in all, the annual conference was a tremendous success.

All in the same boat.definition: Cùng chung hội chung thuyền, cùng cảnh ngộ.
All in the same boat.example: During the pandemic, we were all in the same boat, trying to adjust to new norms.

All kidding aside.definition: Nói nghiêm túc nhé, đùa thế đủ rồi.
All kidding aside.example: All kidding aside, we really need to focus and finish this project by Friday.

All over the map.definition: Lung tung, không có định hướng rõ ràng, lan man.
All over the map.example: Her speech was all over the map, covering too many unrelated topics.

All set.definition: Đã sẵn sàng, đã chuẩn bị xong.
All set.example: We’re all set for the trip. Did you pack your bag?

All thumbs.example: He’s all thumbs in the kitchen and always makes a mess.

All wet.example: He’s all wet if he thinks the boss will approve that plan.

Along for the ride.definition: Đi theo cho vui, tham gia mà không đóng vai trò gì.
Along for the ride.example: He wasn’t an active participant in the project; he was just along for the ride.

An about-face.definition: Sự thay đổi 180 độ (ý kiến, kế hoạch).
An about-face.example: The company did an about-face on its policy after the customer backlash.

An albatross around my neck.definition: Gánh nặng đeo bám, của nợ.
An albatross around my neck.example: His criminal record is an albatross around his neck, stopping him from getting a job.

An apple a day keeps the doctor away.definition: Mỗi ngày một quả táo, cả đời không phải gặp bác sĩ (ăn uống lành mạnh giúp khỏe mạnh).
An apple a day keeps the doctor away.example: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.

An old head on young shoulders.definition: Trẻ người non dạ nhưng suy nghĩ thấu đáo; già dặn trước tuổi.
An old head on young shoulders.example: Despite being only 12, she speaks with the wisdom of someone many years older, truly an old head on young shoulders.

An old soul.definition: Người có tâm hồn già cỗi, chín chắn và sâu sắc trước tuổi.
An old soul.example: His thoughtful and introspective nature makes everyone see him as an old soul.

an old wives' tale.definition: Quan niệm mê tín dân gian vô căn cứ, chuyện truyền miệng thất thiệt.
an old wives' tale.example: The idea that eating carrots gives you night vision is mostly an old wives' tale.

An open book.definition: Người dễ đoán, không giấu giếm điều gì.
An open book.example: Unlike her sister, Sarah is an open book and shares everything about her life.

An ounce of prevention is worth a pound.example: She always follows the saying 'an ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure' by keeping her house well-maintained.

apple of my eye.definition: Báu vật / cục cưng / người được yêu thương cưng chiều nhất.
apple of my eye.example: His little granddaughter is the apple of his eye.

Are you kidding me?.definition: Cậu đang đùa mình đấy à?
Are you kidding me?.example: Are you kidding me? There’s no way she finished that project in one day.

Armchair quarterback.definition: Người giỏi phán xét sau khi sự việc đã rồi (chuyên gia chém gió).
Armchair quarterback.example: It’s easy to be an armchair quarterback when you’re not the one making the tough decisions.

Armed to the teeth.definition: Trang bị tận răng, vũ trang đầy đủ.
Armed to the teeth.example: He entered the meeting armed to the teeth with data and reports.

around the clock.definition: Suốt ngày đêm không ngừng nghỉ, 24/7.
around the clock.example: Rescue teams worked around the clock to clear the debris and find survivors.

Around-the-clock.example: The tech team is working around-the-clock to fix the server issues.

As busy as a bee.definition: Bận rộn tối mắt tối mũi, bận rộn như ong.
As busy as a bee.example: She was as busy as a bee organizing the event.

as cool as a cucumber.definition: Điềm tĩnh như không, cực kỳ bình tĩnh và tỉnh táo.
as cool as a cucumber.example: Even under intense pressure during the live interview, the politician remained as cool as a cucumber.

As easy as ABC.definition: Dễ như trở bàn tay, dễ như ăn kẹo.
As easy as ABC.example: Learning how to use this phone is as easy as ABC.

As easy as pie.definition: Dễ như ăn bánh, dễ như trở bàn tay.
As easy as pie.example: Fixing the computer was as easy as pie for her.

As genuine as a three-dollar bill.definition: Giả tạo, hoàn toàn không đáng tin.
As genuine as a three-dollar bill.example: His apology was as genuine as a three-dollar bill.

As happy as a clam.definition: Cực kỳ vui sướng và mãn nguyện.
As happy as a clam.example: After getting the promotion, he was as happy as a clam.

As quiet as a mouse.definition: Im lặng như tờ, im lặng như chuột.
As quiet as a mouse.example: She was as quiet as a mouse when sneaking into the kitchen for a midnight snack.

As rare as hen’s teeth.definition: Hiếm như lá mùa thu, vô cùng quý hiếm.
As rare as hen’s teeth.example: Honest politicians are as rare as hen’s teeth these days.

As right as rain.definition: Khỏe mạnh trở lại, hoàn toàn ổn thỏa.
As right as rain.example: After a few days of rest, I’m feeling as right as rain.

As the crow flies.example: The village is about 10 miles away as the crow flies.

As white as a sheet/as white as a ghost.definition: Trắng bệch như tờ giấy (vì sợ hãi, bệnh tật).
As white as a sheet/as white as a ghost.example: When she heard the news, she turned as white as a sheet.

At best.definition: Tốt nhất là, cùng lắm là.
At best.example: At best, the project will be completed by next month.

At least.example: We were late, but at least we got to see the end of the movie.

At loggerheads.definition: Bất đồng gay gắt, mâu thuẫn đối đầu.
At loggerheads.example: The two politicians have been at loggerheads over the new policy.

At my wits’ end.definition: Bó tay, hết cách, không biết làm sao nữa.
At my wits’ end.example: After trying everything to get the project back on track, I’m at my wits’ end.

At the bottom of the totem pole.definition: Ở vị trí thấp kém nhất, dưới đáy xã hội/tổ chức.
At the bottom of the totem pole.example: As a new intern, I started at the bottom of the totem pole.

At the crack of dawn.definition: Vào lúc bình minh, sáng sớm tinh mơ.
At the crack of dawn.example: Farmers often wake up at the crack of dawn to tend to their fields.

At the drop of a hat.definition: Ngay lập tức, không do dự.
At the drop of a hat.example: He would help his friends at the drop of a hat.

At the end of your rope.definition: Tới giới hạn chịu đựng, không thể chịu nổi nữa.
At the end of your rope.example: I’m really at the end of my rope with this project; nothing seems to work.

At-large.definition: tự do, chưa bị bắt (tội phạm); đại diện cho toàn khu vực bầu cử
At-large.example: The criminal is still at-large and considered dangerous.

Come out of one's shell.definition: Bớt rụt rè, trở nên cởi mở và tự tin hơn.

Cool as a cucumber.definition: Vô cùng bình tĩnh, điềm nhiên như không.

Do something at the drop of a hat.example: She's always ready to help her friends at the drop of a hat.

Do something by the seat of your pants.definition: Làm việc theo bản năng, không có kế hoạch trước.
Do something by the seat of your pants.example: He decided to fix the bike by the seat of his pants, even though he had no experience.

Doesn't hold water.example: His explanation for being late just doesn't hold water.

Doesn't know beans about it.definition: Không biết tí gì về chuyện đó, mù tịt.
Doesn't know beans about it.example: He doesn't know beans about car mechanics.

Dog and pony show.definition: Buổi biểu diễn màu mè, làm màu.
Dog and pony show.example: The investors saw right through the dog and pony show and asked for more concrete details.

Dog days of summer.definition: Những ngày nóng nực nhất của mùa hè.
Dog days of summer.example: The dog days of summer make it hard to enjoy outdoor activities.

Dog-eat-dog.definition: Cạnh tranh khốc liệt, cá lớn nuốt cá bé.
Dog-eat-dog.example: The corporate world can often be a dog-eat-dog environment.

Dollars to doughnuts.definition: Dám cá là, chắc chắn là.
Dollars to doughnuts.example: Dollars to doughnuts, they'll be late again.

Don't beat a dead horse.definition: Tốn công vô ích, nhai đi nhai lại một vấn đề đã ngã ngũ.
Don't beat a dead horse.example: We have already decided to go with the new plan. Let's not beat a dead horse.

Don't count your chickens before they ha.definition: Đếm cua trong lỗ, nói trước bước không qua.
Don't count your chickens before they ha.example: You may get the promotion, but don't count your chickens before they hatch.

Don't cry over spilt milk.definition: Đừng tiếc rẻ những gì đã mất.
Don't cry over spilt milk.example: You failed the test, but don't cry over spilt milk; focus on the next one.

Don't do anything I wouldn't do.definition: Đừng làm gì bậy bạ nhé (lời khuyên đùa cợt).
Don't do anything I wouldn't do.example: Have fun on your trip, and don't do anything I wouldn't do!

Don't give up your day job.definition: Đừng bỏ công việc chính (ý chê bai tài năng mới không đủ giỏi để kiếm sống).
Don't give up your day job.example: His singing is bad, so don't give up your day job.

Don't hold your breath.example: If you're waiting for him to apologize, don't hold your breath.

Don't know him from Adam.definition: Hoàn toàn không biết người đó là ai.
Don't know him from Adam.example: I wouldn't trust him with my car; I don't know him from Adam.

Don't know if I'm coming or going.definition: Rối bời, không biết đường nào mà lần.
Don't know if I'm coming or going.example: With all these deadlines, I don't know if I'm coming or going.

Don't look a gift horse in the mouth.definition: Đừng săm soi món quà được tặng.
Don't look a gift horse in the mouth.example: Even if it's not exactly what you wanted, don't look a gift horse in the mouth.

Don't put all your eggs in one basket.definition: Đừng bỏ tất cả trứng vào một giỏ (đừng mạo hiểm dồn hết mọi thứ vào một chỗ).
Don't put all your eggs in one basket.example: For his new business, he decided to diversify his product line rather than put all his eggs in one basket.

Don't quote me on that.definition: Đừng trích lời tôi nhé (tôi không chắc chắn 100% đâu).
Don't quote me on that.example: I think the meeting is at 3 PM, but don't quote me on that.

Don't sweat the small stuff.definition: Đừng bận tâm những chuyện vặt vãnh.
Don't sweat the small stuff.example: Life's too short to worry about every little mistake. Don't sweat the small stuff.

Don't throw the baby out with the bath w.definition: Đừng vứt bỏ thứ quý giá cùng với những thứ vô ích.
Don't throw the baby out with the bath w.example: While redesigning the website, don't throw the baby out with the bath water; keep what works well.

Don't want to hear that.definition: Không muốn nghe, từ chối chấp nhận sự thật.
Don't want to hear that.example: I don't want to hear that you're quitting the team.

Done to a turn.definition: Chín tới (thức ăn) hoặc làm hoàn hảo (công việc).
Done to a turn.example: The steak was done to a turn, juicy and flavorful.

Doom and gloom.example: Despite the doom and gloom prediction, the company posted record profits.

Double whammy.definition: Họa vô đơn chí, tổn thất kép.
Double whammy.example: Losing his job and wrecking his car on the same day was a real double whammy for John.

Down in the dumps.example: Jane's been down in the dumps since she lost her job.

Down in the mouth.example: After hearing the bad news, she was really down in the mouth.

Down the tube.definition: Đổ sông đổ biển, thất bại hoàn toàn.
Down the tube.example: All the time and effort went down the tube when the project was canceled.

down to earth.definition: Thực tế, bình dị, gần gũi, không kiểu cách.
down to earth.example: Despite her massive international fame, she remains remarkably down to earth.

down to the wire.definition: Tới phút chót, đến phút cuối cùng mới ngã ngũ.
down to the wire.example: The election came down to the wire with results revealed just before midnight.

down-to-earth.definition: Thực tế, giản dị, không viển vông.
down-to-earth.example: Despite his success, he remains down-to-earth and humble.

drag one's feet.definition: Chần chừ, cố ý kéo dài thời gian (vì miễn cưỡng).
drag one's feet.example: The committee is dragging its feet on making a final decision.

drastic times call for drastic measures.definition: Tình thế nguy cấp đòi hỏi những biện pháp quyết liệt (tùy cơ ứng biến).
drastic times call for drastic measures.example: During the economic crisis, the government decided that drastic times call for drastic measures and implemented severe budget cuts.

draw a blank.definition: Trống rỗng, không nhớ ra được gì, không tìm thấy kết quả.
draw a blank.example: I tried to remember her name, but I completely drew a blank.

drawing card.definition: Yếu tố thu hút, sức hút chính (đối với khán giả hoặc khách hàng).
drawing card.example: The new roller coaster is the main drawing card of the amusement park.

dressed to kill.definition: Ăn mặc lộng lẫy, diện đồ lồng lộn để gây ấn tượng mạnh.
dressed to kill.example: She arrived at the party dressed to kill, with a stunning red gown that caught everyone's eye.

Drink like a fish.definition: Uống rượu như nước lã, nhậu nhẹt nát rượu.
Drink like a fish.example: After his breakup, he started to drink like a fish every night.

drive someone crazy.definition: Làm ai phát điên, làm ai phát cáu.
drive someone crazy.example: The constant barking of the neighbor's dog is driving me crazy.

drive someone nuts.definition: Làm ai đó phát điên, chọc tức ai đó.
drive someone nuts.example: The constant noise from the construction site is driving me nuts.

drive someone up the wall.definition: Làm ai đó bực tức, phát điên lên được.
drive someone up the wall.example: The constant noise from the construction site is driving me up the wall.

drop by.definition: Ghé ngang qua, tạt qua (thăm viếng ngắn).
drop by.example: Feel free to drop by my office if you have any questions.

drop out of school.example: Several tech founders famously dropped out of school to start their companies.

drop someone a line.definition: Viết vài dòng, gửi một tin nhắn hoặc lá thư ngắn cho ai đó.
drop someone a line.example: I'll drop you a line when I get to Paris.

drop-dead gorgeous.definition: Đẹp rạng ngời, đẹp nghiêng nước nghiêng thành.
drop-dead gorgeous.example: She walked into the room, and everyone was stunned because she looked drop-dead gorgeous.

dry run.definition: Buổi diễn tập, buổi chạy thử.
dry run.example: Let's do a dry run of the presentation to make sure everything goes smoothly.

dyed-in-the-wool.definition: Cố hữu, thâm căn cố đế, không thể thay đổi.
dyed-in-the-wool.example: He's a dyed-in-the-wool conservative; no argument will change his mind.

eager beaver.definition: Người nhiệt tình, tham công tiếc việc, hăng hái quá mức.
eager beaver.example: John is such an eager beaver; he volunteers for every project.

easy come, easy go.definition: Của thiên trả địa, dễ đến dễ đi.
easy come, easy go.example: He spent his lottery winnings in a month — easy come, easy go.

easy does it.definition: Cẩn thận nào, từ từ thôi, nhẹ tay thôi.
easy does it.example: Easy does it when you're carrying those dishes.

eat crow.definition: Phải nhận sai, phải muối mặt thừa nhận mình đã lầm.
eat crow.example: After insisting that he was right, John had to eat crow when the true facts came out.

eat like a bird.definition: Ăn nhỏ nhẻ, ăn ít như mèo.
eat like a bird.example: She always eats like a bird, barely finishing her plate.

eat like a horse.definition: Ăn thùng bất chiêng, ăn rất khỏe.
eat like a horse.example: He eats like a horse; he finished three plates of pasta!

eat one's hat.definition: Chắc chắn không xảy ra (nếu xảy ra thì tôi đi đầu xuống đất).
eat one's hat.example: If he wins the lottery, I'll eat my hat.

eat one's heart out.definition: Ghen tị đi nha, cứ thèm thuồng đi.
eat one's heart out.example: I've got front-row tickets to see Taylor Swift. Eat your heart out!

egg on one's face.definition: Bẽ mặt, xấu hổ vì bị quê / làm trò cười.
egg on one's face.example: He had egg on his face when his confident prediction about the stock market turned out completely wrong.

elevator pitch.definition: Bài thuyết trình ngắn gọn (chỉ vài chục giây), lời tự giới thiệu súc tích.
elevator pitch.example: In just two minutes, he delivered a convincing elevator pitch to the investors.

eleventh hour.definition: Phút chót, giờ thứ 11 (thời khắc cuối cùng trước khi quá muộn).
eleventh hour.example: The labor union reached an agreement with management at the eleventh hour, avoiding a strike.

Elvis has left the building.definition: Mọi chuyện đã kết thúc, vãn tuồng rồi.
Elvis has left the building.example: The show is over. It's time to go home; Elvis has left the building.

empty nest syndrome.definition: Hội chứng tổ trống (cảm giác cô đơn, trống trải của cha mẹ khi con cái trưởng thành dọn ra ở riêng).
empty nest syndrome.example: After their youngest daughter went to college, they experienced empty nest syndrome.

every cloud has a silver lining.definition: Trong cái rủi có cái may, sau cơn mưa trời lại sáng.
every cloud has a silver lining.example: After losing his job, he realized that every cloud has a silver lining when he found a better position.

every dog has his day.definition: Ai rồi cũng có lúc vinh quang, sông có khúc người có lúc.
every dog has his day.example: He finally got his breakthrough. I guess every dog has his day.

every now and then.example: I like to take a walk every now and then to clear my mind.

everything but the kitchen sink.definition: Thượng vàng hạ cám, đem theo mọi thứ có thể (đồ lỉnh kỉnh).
everything but the kitchen sink.example: They packed everything but the kitchen sink for their camping trip.

exact change.definition: Tiền lẻ trả vừa đủ (không cần thối lại).
exact change.example: Do you have exact change for the bus fare?

excuse my French / pardon my French.definition: Xin lỗi vì đã văng tục/nói bậy.
excuse my French / pardon my French.example: He's such a... pardon my French, jerk.

extended family.definition: Đại gia đình (bao gồm ông bà, cô dì chú bác, anh em họ).
extended family.example: During the Lunar New Year, our whole extended family gathers for a festive reunion dinner.

face the music.definition: Dám làm dám chịu, đối mặt với hậu quả.
face the music.example: After avoiding his responsibilities for months, John finally had to face the music and confess his mistakes.

fair and square.definition: Công bằng, đường đường chính chính.
fair and square.example: He won the competition fair and square.

fair to middling.definition: Thường thường bậc trung, tàm tạm.
fair to middling.example: My health is fair to middling at the moment.

fair-weather friend.definition: Bạn bè khi vui thì vỗ tay vào (lúc hoạn nạn thì bỏ đi), bạn đểu.
fair-weather friend.example: I realized he was just a fair-weather friend when he wasn't there for me during hard times.

fall by the wayside.definition: Bỏ cuộc giữa chừng, thất bại, rơi rụng dần.
fall by the wayside.example: Many good ideas fall by the wayside due to lack of funding.

fall into place.definition: Vào guồng, đâu vào đấy một cách trôi chảy và thuận lợi.
fall into place.example: Once we secured the project funding, all other details fell into place.

fall off the wagon.definition: Ngựa quen đường cũ, tái nghiện (đặc biệt là rượu).
fall off the wagon.example: John was doing well with his diet, but he fell off the wagon and started eating junk food again.

fall on deaf ears.definition: Bỏ ngoài tai, đàn gảy tai trâu.
fall on deaf ears.example: The warning fell on deaf ears, and no one took action.

familiarity breeds contempt.definition: Quá gần gũi đâm ra khinh nhờn, thân quá hóa nhờn.
familiarity breeds contempt.example: After working with him for years, she realized that familiarity breeds contempt and they no longer got along.

fancy pants.definition: Kẻ chải chuốt, người thích ăn diện lòe loẹt.
fancy pants.example: Look at Mr. Fancy Pants over there with his shiny new car.

far and wide.definition: Khắp nơi, rộng khắp, xa gần.
far and wide.example: People came from far and wide to attend the annual cultural festival.

fashion victim.definition: Nạn nhân của thời trang (chạy theo mốt một cách mù quáng).
fashion victim.example: She buys every new design but ends up looking like a fashion victim.

fat cat.definition: Kẻ trọc phú, tư bản gộc (quyền thế và giàu có).
fat cat.example: Many people believe that the fat cats on Wall Street have too much influence over the government.

feather one's nest.definition: Thu vén cá nhân, vơ vét của công làm của riêng.
feather one's nest.example: The corrupt official used the charity funds to feather his own nest.

feeding frenzy.definition: Sự tranh giành điên cuồng, cơn sốt xâu xé.
feeding frenzy.example: Investors went into a feeding frenzy when the company's stock price started rising rapidly.

feel blue.definition: Cảm thấy buồn bã, ủ rũ.
feel blue.example: Whenever I feel blue, going for a brisk walk outdoors helps lift my spirits.

feel like a million dollars.definition: Cảm thấy khỏe khoắn tuyệt vời, sung sức ngập tràn.
feel like a million dollars.example: After a good night's sleep, you'll feel like a million dollars.

feel the pinch.definition: Bắt đầu thiếu hụt tiền bạc, cảm thấy gánh nặng tài chính.
feel the pinch.example: With the rising cost of living, many families are beginning to feel the pinch.

Feeling blue.definition: Cảm thấy buồn bã, chán nản.
Feeling blue.example: She's been feeling blue ever since her pet dog passed away.

feeling under the weather.definition: Cảm thấy hơi mệt, khó ở trong người.
feeling under the weather.example: She left the office early because she was feeling under the weather.

Fender bender.definition: Vụ va chạm xe nhẹ, không nghiêm trọng.
Fender bender.example: I got into a fender bender on my way to work.

Field day.definition: Dịp vui vẻ, ngày hội (hoặc cơ hội lợi dụng tình hình để làm điều mình thích).
Field day.example: The media had a field day with the politician's scandal.

Fifteen minutes of fame.definition: Sự nổi tiếng ngắn ngủi, chớp nhoáng.
Fifteen minutes of fame.example: His viral video brought him fifteen minutes of fame, but now he's back to his normal life.

Fight an uphill battle.definition: Đấu tranh trong hoàn cảnh khó khăn, gian nan.
Fight an uphill battle.example: Starting a new business in this economy feels like fighting an uphill battle.

Fight tooth and nail.definition: Đấu tranh quyết liệt, chiến đấu đến cùng.
Fight tooth and nail.example: She fought tooth and nail to get the promotion.

Fill in the blanks.definition: Điền vào chỗ trống, bổ sung thông tin còn thiếu.
Fill in the blanks.example: I didn't understand the whole plan, but my manager will fill in the blanks for me.

Filthy rich.definition: Vô cùng giàu có, giàu nứt đố đổ vách.
Filthy rich.example: Despite his humble beginnings, he became filthy rich through hard work and innovation.

Find fault with.definition: Bắt bẻ, bới lông tìm vết, chê bai.
Find fault with.example: Instead of being helpful, she just likes to find fault with others.

Find your feet.definition: Trở nên tự tin, quen thuộc với môi trường mới.
Find your feet.example: It took her a few months to find her feet in the new company.

Finger-lickin' good.definition: Ngon tuyệt cú mèo, ngon khó cưỡng.
Finger-lickin' good.example: The barbecue at that new place is finger-lickin' good! It's worth every penny.

Fish out of water.definition: Người lạc lõng, cảm thấy không thoải mái trong môi trường lạ.
Fish out of water.example: At her new job, she felt like a fish out of water, not knowing anyone or how things worked.

Fishy.example: The deal sounds fishy to me; I think we should investigate further.

Fit as a fiddle.definition: Cực kỳ khỏe mạnh, sung sức.
Fit as a fiddle.example: After his recovery from the flu, he is now fit as a fiddle.

Fit to be tied.definition: Cực kỳ tức giận, nổi trận lôi đình.
Fit to be tied.example: When she found out her flight was canceled, she was fit to be tied.

Fits and starts.definition: Thất thường, không đều đặn (làm việc chập chờn).
Fits and starts.example: Their progress on the project was made in fits and starts.

Five o'clock shadow.definition: Râu mọc lún phún (sau một ngày dài không cạo râu).
Five o'clock shadow.example: He had a five o'clock shadow by the time the meeting ended.

Fix someone's wagon.definition: Dạy cho ai đó một bài học, phá đám ai đó.
Fix someone's wagon.example: Don't worry, we'll fix their wagon for trying to cheat us.

Fixed in one's ways.definition: Bảo thủ, không chịu thay đổi thói quen.
Fixed in one's ways.example: My grandfather is quite fixed in his ways and refuses to use a smartphone.

Flavor of the month.definition: Trào lưu nhất thời, người/vật nổi lên chốc lát.
Flavor of the month.example: That singer might be the flavor of the month, but will people remember his songs next year?

Flea market.example: We found some amazing vintage items at the flea market last weekend.

Flesh and blood.definition: Máu mủ ruột thịt, người nhà.
Flesh and blood.example: He is my flesh and blood; I will always support him.

Fly in the face of something.definition: Đi ngược lại, chống đối hoàn toàn (quan điểm, quy tắc).
Fly in the face of something.example: To deny climate change is to fly in the face of overwhelming scientific evidence.

Fly in the ointment.definition: Con sâu làm rầu nồi canh, điều gây mất vui.
Fly in the ointment.example: Everything was perfect for the trip, but the flight delay was a real fly in the ointment.

Fly off the handle.definition: Đột nhiên nổi cáu, mất bình tĩnh.
Fly off the handle.example: When he heard the bad news, he flew off the handle and started shouting.

Fly the coop.example: As soon as the boss left, the workers all flew the coop.

fly through.definition: Làm/vượt qua cái gì một cách vèo vèo, siêu nhanh và dễ dàng.
fly through.example: Because he prepared so well, he flew through the math exam in just 30 minutes.

Fly-by-night.definition: Làm ăn chớp nhoáng, không đáng tin cậy.
Fly-by-night.example: The investment looked promising, but it turned out to be a fly-by-night scam.

Foam at the mouth.definition: Tức sùi bọt mép, giận điên người.
Foam at the mouth.example: He started to foam at the mouth when he heard about the unfair decision.

Follow in someone's footsteps.definition: Nối nghiệp, theo bước chân ai đó.
Follow in someone's footsteps.example: She decided to follow in her mother's footsteps and become a doctor.

Follow the money.definition: Lần theo dấu vết tiền bạc (để tìm ra sự thật).
Follow the money.example: In many corruption cases, investigators usually follow the money to find evidence.

Follow up on something.definition: Theo dõi, tiếp tục xử lý, bám sát (một vấn đề/công việc).
Follow up on something.example: Can you follow up on the project status with the team?

Food for thought.definition: Điều đáng suy ngẫm, gợi suy nghĩ.
Food for thought.example: Her lecture provided a lot of food for thought about the future of technology.

Fool around.definition: Chơi đùa nhảm nhí, làm chuyện vớ vẩn.
Fool around.example: Stop fooling around and focus on your homework.

Fool's gold.definition: Vàng thau lẫn lộn, vật lấp lánh nhưng vô giá trị.
Fool's gold.example: The investment seemed promising, but it turned out to be fool's gold.

Foot in the door.definition: Bước chân vào nghề, cơ hội ban đầu.
Foot in the door.example: Getting an internship is a good way to get your foot in the door of the industry.

foot the bill.definition: Đứng ra thanh toán toàn bộ chi phí/hóa đơn.
foot the bill.example: The company agreed to foot the bill for all our travel and hotel expenses.

Footloose and fancy-free.definition: Tự do tự tại, không bị ràng buộc.
Footloose and fancy-free.example: She's been traveling the world, footloose and fancy-free, ever since she quit her job.

For crying out loud.definition: Bực mình quá đi mất, thật là bực bội!
For crying out loud.example: For crying out loud, can you please turn down the music?

For goodness' sake.definition: Trời đất ơi, lạy Chúa tôi (thể hiện sự mất kiên nhẫn).
For goodness' sake.example: For goodness' sake, turn the music down!

For heaven's sake.definition: Vì Chúa, ơn trời (biểu lộ sự kinh ngạc hoặc bực dọc).
For heaven's sake.example: For heaven's sake, clean up your room!

For the birds.definition: Vô nghĩa, vớ vẩn, nhảm nhí.
For the birds.example: All this paperwork is for the birds. I prefer real, hands-on work.

Fork over / Shell out money.definition: Bấm bụng chi tiền, nôn tiền ra.
Fork over / Shell out money.example: You'll need to shell out some cash for this top-of-the-line laptop.

Fortune favors the bold.definition: Liều ăn nhiều, dũng cảm sẽ gặp may mắn.
Fortune favors the bold.example: He took a risk by starting his own business, but fortune favors the bold.

Forty winks.example: After a busy morning, I need forty winks to recharge.

Freak out.definition: Hoảng sợ tột độ, mất bình tĩnh.
Freak out.example: She started to freak out when she realized she had lost her wallet.

fresh as a daisy.definition: Tươi như hoa, tràn đầy năng lượng sau giấc ngủ ngon.
fresh as a daisy.example: After a good eight hours of sound sleep, she woke up fresh as a daisy.
