Green around the gills.example: He looked green around the gills after the roller coaster ride.

Green room.definition: Phòng chờ (dành cho diễn viên, khách mời trước khi lên sân khấu).
Green room.example: The actors chatted with each other in the green room before the show.

Green thumb.definition: Có tay trồng cây, mát tay trồng trọt.
Green thumb.example: She must have a green thumb because her garden is always full of beautiful flowers.

green with envy.definition: Ghen tị đỏ mắt, vô cùng đố kỵ.
green with envy.example: When they saw his luxury sports car, all his colleagues were green with envy.

Grin and bear it.definition: Cắn răng chịu đựng, ngậm đắng nuốt cay.
Grin and bear it.example: Even though the project was stressful he chose to grin and bear it until it was completed.

Guinea pig.example: They used me as a guinea pig for their new training program.

Gung ho.definition: Hăng hái, nhiệt tình, hừng hực khí thế.
Gung ho.example: He’s so gung ho about the new project, it’s contagious.

Gut feeling.example: I had a gut feeling that something was wrong.

Hair of the dog.definition: Rượu giải rượu, lấy độc trị độc (uống thêm rượu để chữa say rượu).
Hair of the dog.example: He had a bad hangover, so he decided to have a hair of the dog in the morning.

Hair’s breadth.definition: Đường tơ kẽ tóc, trong gang tấc.
Hair’s breadth.example: The car missed the pedestrian by a hair’s breadth.

Half a mind to do something.definition: Có ý định, nửa muốn nửa không (thường vì tức giận nhưng chưa quyết hẳn).
Half a mind to do something.example: She has half a mind to tell her boss off, but she won’t.

Half the battle.definition: Một nửa thành công, đã giải quyết được phần khó khăn nhất.
Half the battle.example: Understanding the problem is half the battle.

Half-baked.definition: Chưa chín chắn, thiếu suy nghĩ, nửa vời.
Half-baked.example: He came up with a half-baked scheme to start a business without any market research.

Hammer out a deal.definition: Thỏa thuận thành công, chốt được hợp đồng sau khi thương lượng căng thẳng.
Hammer out a deal.example: After weeks of negotiation the two companies finally hammered out a deal.

Hand in glove.definition: Cấu kết chặt chẽ, ăn ý với nhau (thường mang nghĩa tiêu cực hoặc ám muội).
Hand in glove.example: Those two companies have been operating hand in glove for years.

Hand over fist.definition: Vớ bở, kiếm hoặc mất (tiền) nhanh như nước.
Hand over fist.example: The new product was a hit and the company started making money hand over fist.

Handle someone with kid gloves.definition: Đối xử một cách nhẹ nhàng, thận trọng (vì ai đó nhạy cảm)
Handle someone with kid gloves.example: He has been very stressed lately, so please handle him with kid gloves.

Hang in there.definition: Cố gắng lên, đừng bỏ cuộc, kiên trì nhé.
Hang in there.example: I know the exam is tough, but hang in there; you’ll do great.

Hang tight.definition: Cứ chờ ở đó, kiên nhẫn đợi một chút.
Hang tight.example: Hang tight, the doctor will be with you shortly.

Happy-go-lucky.definition: Vô tư lự, lạc quan, phó mặc cho số phận.
Happy-go-lucky.example: She’s always been a happy-go-lucky person never worrying too much about what tomorrow brings.

hard nut to crack.definition: Vấn đề hóc búa nan giải; người cứng đầu khó thuyết phục.
hard nut to crack.example: Analyzing customer retention in this market has proven to be a hard nut to crack.

Hard pill to swallow.definition: Sự thật phũ phàng, điều đắng cay khó chấp nhận.
Hard pill to swallow.example: Losing the championship game was a hard pill to swallow for the team.

Hard sell.definition: Cách bán hàng ép buộc, ép mua bằng được.
Hard sell.example: The car salesman was giving me a hard sell on the latest model.

Haste makes waste.example: Don’t rush through your homework; remember, haste makes waste.

Have an axe to grind.definition: Có ý đồ riêng, có động cơ cá nhân, có xích mích cần giải quyết.
Have an axe to grind.example: Be careful when talking to him; he always seems to have an axe to grind.

Have another thing coming.definition: Lầm to rồi, cứ chờ đấy mà xem.
Have another thing coming.example: If he thinks he'll get away without punishment, he has another thing coming.

Have bats in one’s belfry.definition: Bị chập mạch, hâm dở, gàn dở.
Have bats in one’s belfry.example: People say he’s got bats in his belfry because of his strange inventions.

Have bigger fish to fry.definition: Có việc quan trọng hơn cần giải quyết.
Have bigger fish to fry.example: He didn’t attend the meeting because he has bigger fish to fry at the moment.

have egg on one's face.definition: Bẽ mặt, xấu hổ vì mắc sai lầm.
have egg on one's face.example: When the CEO's prediction about the market was completely wrong, he ended up with egg on his face.

Have hell to pay.definition: Gặp rắc rối lớn, phải trả giá đắt.
Have hell to pay.example: If he finds out you broke his favorite vase, you’ll have hell to pay.

Have one's back to the wall.definition: Bị dồn vào chân tường, ở thế bí.
Have one's back to the wall.example: With no other options, he felt like he had his back to the wall and had to fight.

have one's ducks in a row.definition: Chuẩn bị kỹ càng, sắp xếp mọi thứ đâu ra đấy.
have one's ducks in a row.example: Before the big presentation, I need to make sure I have my ducks in a row.

Have one's head in the clouds.definition: Mơ mộng hão huyền, để tâm hồn treo ngược cành cây.
Have one's head in the clouds.example: He’s always got his head in the clouds during meetings.

Have one's heart set on.definition: Vô cùng khao khát; quyết tâm đạt được.
Have one's heart set on.example: My heart is set on going to Paris for vacation this year.

Have something down pat.definition: Nắm rõ như lòng bàn tay, thuộc làu làu, thành thạo.
Have something down pat.example: She has the whole presentation down pat and can deliver it without any notes.

Have the world by the tail.definition: Nắm chắc phần thắng, làm chủ thế giới, đang ở đỉnh cao danh vọng.
Have the world by the tail.example: After landing his dream job he felt like he had the world by the tail.

Have time off.definition: Nghỉ phép, có thời gian rảnh rỗi.
Have time off.example: I need to have some time off to relax and recharge.

Have two left feet.definition: Vụng về, lóng ngóng (đặc biệt là khi khiêu vũ).
Have two left feet.example: When it comes to dancing, John has two left feet.

He who laughs last laughs loudest.definition: Cười người hôm trước hôm sau người cười; người chiến thắng cuối cùng mới là người giỏi nhất.
He who laughs last laughs loudest.example: John didn’t do well in the early rounds, but he who laughs last laughs loudest — he won the championship.

Head and shoulders above.definition: Vượt trội hoàn toàn, xuất sắc hơn hẳn.
Head and shoulders above.example: In terms of problem-solving skills Jane is head and shoulders above her peers.

Head honcho.definition: Người sếp cao nhất, người đứng đầu.
Head honcho.example: The head honcho will be in town next week for the annual meeting.

Head in the clouds.definition: Để tâm hồn trên mây, viển vông, xa rời thực tế.
Head in the clouds.example: She’s a dreamer with her head in the clouds but she has great ideas.

Head over heels.definition: Say đắm, mê mệt (thường nói về tình yêu).
Head over heels.example: He’s head over heels in love with her.

Heads-up.definition: Lời báo trước, thông báo trước.
Heads-up.example: Thanks for the heads-up about the meeting tomorrow.

Hear it on the grapevine.example: I heard it on the grapevine that they are planning to merge with another company.

Hear something straight from the horse’s.definition: Nghe từ chính chủ, lấy thông tin từ nguồn đáng tin cậy nhất.
Hear something straight from the horse’s.example: I heard the news straight from the horse’s mouth; the CEO himself confirmed it.

Heebie-jeebies.definition: Nổi da gà, rợn tóc gáy, sợ hãi, ớn lạnh.
Heebie-jeebies.example: The creepy old house gave me the heebie-jeebies.

helicopter parent.definition: Phụ huynh trực thăng (cha mẹ bảo bọc, kiểm soát con cái thái quá mọi lúc mọi nơi).
helicopter parent.example: Her mother was a classic helicopter parent who called the teacher over every minor dispute.

Here and there.definition: Chỗ này chỗ kia, rải rác, thỉnh thoảng.
Here and there.example: We found small cafes here and there in the city.

High on the hog.definition: Sống xa hoa, ăn sung mặc sướng.
High on the hog.example: Ever since he got his promotion he’s been living high on the hog.

High, wide, and handsome.definition: Đầy tự tin và phóng khoáng; đường hoàng đĩnh đạc.
High, wide, and handsome.example: He entered the room, high, wide, and handsome, capturing everyone's attention.

Hissy fit.definition: Cơn thịnh nộ vô cớ; ăn vạ (thường dùng với ý hài hước).
Hissy fit.example: She threw a hissy fit just because her coffee was cold.

Hit it on the nose.definition: Nói đúng phóc; đoán trúng phóc.
Hit it on the nose.example: Your analysis of the sales trends was right; you hit it on the nose.

Hit me up.definition: Liên lạc với tôi; nhắn tin/gọi cho tôi nhé.
Hit me up.example: I'm free this weekend, hit me up if you want to hang out.

Hit pay dirt.definition: Trúng quả đậm; tìm thấy mỏ vàng.
Hit pay dirt.example: The startup hit pay dirt when they launched their innovative app.

Hit someone below the belt.definition: Chơi đòn hiểm; đánh dưới thắt lưng (công kích cá nhân một cách hèn hạ).
Hit someone below the belt.example: Criticizing someone's family to win an argument is definitely hitting below the belt.

Hit the books.definition: Vùi đầu vào sách vở; cắm đầu vào học.
Hit the books.example: I've got a big exam next week, so it's time to hit the books.

Hit the ceiling.definition: Nổi trận lôi đình; tức điên lên.
Hit the ceiling.example: My dad hit the ceiling when I told him I crashed the car.

Hit the hay.definition: Đi ngủ; lên giường đi ngủ.
Hit the hay.example: I'm really exhausted; it's time to hit the hay.

Hit the jackpot.definition: Trúng số độc đắc; vớ được món hời lớn.
Hit the jackpot.example: They hit the jackpot with their new product; it sold out in a week.

Hit the nail on the head.definition: Nói trúng tim đen; nói đúng phóc.
Hit the nail on the head.example: You really hit the nail on the head with your analysis of the problem.

Hit the road.example: We should hit the road early to avoid traffic.

Hit the sack.example: I'm really tired, so I'm going to hit the sack early tonight.

hit the spot.definition: gãi đúng chỗ ngứa, đúng thứ đang thèm
hit the spot.example: After a long hike, a cold lemonade really hit the spot.

Hocus-pocus.definition: Trò bịp bợm; trò ma thuật.
Hocus-pocus.example: Don't believe his hocus-pocus; it's all sleight of hand.

hold ground.definition: Giữ vững vị trí, kiên định không nhượng bộ.
hold ground.example: The debate team held their ground skillfully during the challenging questioning.

Hold one's own.definition: Đứng vững, không hề kém cạnh (trong khó khăn, cạnh tranh).
Hold one's own.example: Despite his inexperience, he managed to hold his own in the debate.

Hold out an olive branch.definition: Chìa cành ô liu, tỏ ý muốn hòa giải.
Hold out an olive branch.example: After the heated argument, she decided to hold out an olive branch and apologized.

Hold the fort.definition: Quán xuyến công việc (trong lúc ai đó đi vắng); trông nom nhà cửa.
Hold the fort.example: The manager asked me to hold the fort until she returns.

Hold your horses.definition: Bình tĩnh lại nào; từ từ đã.
Hold your horses.example: Hold your horses, the meeting doesn't start for another 30 minutes.

Hold your tongue.definition: Giữ mồm giữ miệng; im lặng.
Hold your tongue.example: She wanted to argue, but decided to hold her tongue.

Holding the bag.definition: Phải giơ đầu chịu báng; gánh chịu hậu quả một mình.
Holding the bag.example: She ended up holding the bag after her teammates didn't show up for the presentation.

home sweet home.definition: Không đâu bằng nhà mình; mái ấm thân yêu.
home sweet home.example: After traveling abroad for a grueling month, I walked through the door and whispered, 'Home sweet home.'

Hopping mad.definition: Tức nhảy cồ cồ; giận sôi máu.
Hopping mad.example: When she found out about the broken vase, she was hopping mad.

Horse around.definition: Đùa giỡn ầm ĩ; nghịch ngợm.
Horse around.example: Stop horsing around, we need to get this project done!

Horse of a different color.definition: Một chuyện hoàn toàn khác; một vấn đề khác hẳn.
Horse of a different color.example: I thought the meeting was about budget cuts, but it turned out to be a horse of a different color.

Hot under the collar.definition: Nổi giận đùng đùng; bực tức.
Hot under the collar.example: He got hot under the collar when his colleague blamed him for the mistake.

Hot-button issue.definition: Vấn đề nhức nhối; chủ đề gây tranh cãi gay gắt.
Hot-button issue.example: Gun control is a hot-button issue that divides many Americans.

Hotshot.definition: Kẻ xuất chúng nhưng kiêu ngạo; người tài giỏi xuất sắc.
Hotshot.example: She's a hotshot lawyer known for winning difficult cases.

How do you like them apples.definition: Thấy sao hả?; Nhìn mà xem! (dùng khi đắc ý).
How do you like them apples.example: We won the championship! How do you like them apples?

Hunky-dory.definition: Mọi chuyện đều ổn thỏa; êm đẹp.
Hunky-dory.example: Don't worry, everything will be hunky-dory by the weekend.

I can't imagine.definition: Tôi không thể tưởng tượng được.
I can't imagine.example: I can't imagine living without the internet these days.

I don't have two nickels to rub together.definition: Cháy túi; không có một xu dính túi.
I don't have two nickels to rub together.example: After losing my job, I don't have two nickels to rub together.

I suck at something.definition: Tôi rất tệ ở việc gì đó; dở tệ.
I suck at something.example: I really suck at math. I always get bad grades.

I wasn't born yesterday.definition: Tôi đâu có phải trẻ lên ba; tôi đâu có dễ bị lừa.
I wasn't born yesterday.example: You can't trick me with such a simple scam; I wasn't born yesterday.

I'd give my right hand to.definition: Tôi sẵn sàng đánh đổi tất cả để; tôi vô cùng khao khát.
I'd give my right hand to.example: I'd give my right hand to meet my favorite author in person.

I'm losing it.definition: Tôi sắp phát điên rồi; tôi sắp mất kiểm soát rồi.
I'm losing it.example: I'm so stressed out with all these deadlines; I'm losing it.

Icing on the cake.definition: Thêm phần rực rỡ; phần thưởng thêm.
Icing on the cake.example: Getting a promotion was great, but the bonus was the icing on the cake.

Idle hands are the devil's tools.example: Parents often encourage their children to find a hobby because they believe idle hands are the devil's tools.

If I had a nickel for every time somethi.definition: Nếu mỗi lần như vậy tôi có một đồng xu thì tôi đã giàu to; chuyện xảy ra như cơm bữa.
If I had a nickel for every time somethi.example: If I had a nickel for every time my phone battery died, I'd have a lot of nickels.

If worst comes to worst.example: If worst comes to worst, I'll use my savings to cover the expenses.

If you can't stand the heat, get out of.definition: Không chịu được áp lực thì đừng làm.
If you can't stand the heat, get out of.example: Running a business is tough. If you can't stand the heat, get out of the kitchen.

If you play your cards right.definition: Nếu biết cách tính toán; nếu khéo léo xử lý.
If you play your cards right.example: If you play your cards right, you might get that promotion.

Ignorance is bliss.definition: Không biết thì không đau lòng; ngu si hưởng thái bình.
Ignorance is bliss.example: He decided not to tell her about the bad news; after all, ignorance is bliss.

In a bind.definition: Đang gặp rắc rối; rơi vào tình thế tiến thoái lưỡng nan.
In a bind.example: She is really in a bind with all these bills to pay.

In a jam.definition: Đang kẹt cứng; rơi vào hoàn cảnh khó khăn.
In a jam.example: I'm really in a jam right now. My car broke down, and I have no way to get to work.

In a nutshell.example: In a nutshell, the company is facing financial difficulties.

In a pinch.definition: Trong trường hợp khẩn cấp; dùng tạm khi cấp bách.
In a pinch.example: I can use my phone as a flashlight in a pinch.

In a rut.definition: Rơi vào lối mòn; bế tắc trong công việc/cuộc sống.
In a rut.example: She feels like she's in a rut at her current job.

In charge of.definition: Chịu trách nhiệm (quản lý, điều hành).
In charge of.example: She is in charge of the marketing team.

in due course.definition: Đúng lúc, vào thời điểm thích hợp trong tương lai.
in due course.example: Your application will be processed and you will receive a response in due course.

In full swing.definition: Đang ở lúc cao trào; đang hoạt động hết công suất.
In full swing.example: The party was in full swing by the time we arrived.

In high gear.definition: Tăng tốc; làm việc với cường độ cao.
In high gear.example: After the meeting, the team kicked into high gear and started implementing the new plan.

In hot water.definition: Gặp rắc rối lớn; dầu sôi lửa bỏng.
In hot water.example: He got in hot water with his parents after coming home late.

In my book.definition: Theo quan điểm của tôi; theo suy nghĩ của tôi.
In my book.example: In my book, honesty is always the best policy.

In my element.definition: Như cá gặp nước; ở đúng sở trường của mình.
In my element.example: When she's baking in the kitchen, she's truly in her element.

In seventh heaven.definition: Cảm thấy vô cùng sung sướng, hạnh phúc ngất ngây (như ở trên chín tầng mây).
In seventh heaven.example: When she got the promotion, she was in seventh heaven.

In spades.definition: Rất nhiều, ở mức độ cao.
In spades.example: Their hard work paid off in spades when they won the championship.

In stitches.definition: Cười ngặt nghẽo, cười đau cả bụng.
In stitches.example: The comedian had the entire audience in stitches during his performance.

In the bag.definition: Chắc ăn, nắm chắc phần thắng trong tay.
In the bag.example: With the way they are playing, the championship is in the bag.

In the black.definition: Có lãi, làm ăn có lợi nhuận, không bị mắc nợ.
In the black.example: After a tough year, the company is finally in the black.

in the blink of an eye.definition: Trong chớp mắt, trong khoảnh khắc.
in the blink of an eye.example: Summer vacation seemed to pass by in the blink of an eye.

In the boondocks.definition: Ở nơi khỉ ho cò gáy, vùng sâu vùng xa.
In the boondocks.example: His grandparents live way out in the boondocks.

In the chips / In the money.definition: Giàu có, rủng rỉnh tiền bạc.
In the chips / In the money.example: Since landing that high-paying job, Jake has been in the money.

In the doghouse.definition: Đang bị ai đó giận, gặp rắc rối vì làm phật ý người khác.
In the doghouse.example: He forgot their anniversary, so he's really in the doghouse now.

In the heat of the moment.definition: Trong lúc nóng giận hoặc thiếu suy nghĩ do cảm xúc dâng trào.
In the heat of the moment.example: He said something hurtful in the heat of the moment, but later apologized.

In the lap of luxury.definition: Trong nhung lụa, sống xa hoa.
In the lap of luxury.example: They've been living in the lap of luxury since winning the lottery.

In the least.definition: Một chút nào (dùng trong câu phủ định mang nghĩa 'hoàn toàn không').
In the least.example: I'm not worried in the least about the exam.

In the long run.definition: Về lâu về dài, rốt cuộc thì.
In the long run.example: Cutting corners might save money now, but in the long run, it could cost more.

In the loop.definition: Được cập nhật thông tin, nắm rõ tình hình.
In the loop.example: I need to stay in the loop about the project's progress.

In the nick of time.example: The firefighters arrived in the nick of time to save the building from burning down.

In the pink.definition: Vô cùng khỏe mạnh, ở trạng thái sức khỏe tốt nhất.
In the pink.example: After a few weeks of recovery, he's finally in the pink again.

In the red.example: After a bad year, the company found itself in the red.

in the same boat.definition: Cùng chung cảnh ngộ, cùng hội cùng thuyền.
in the same boat.example: None of us finished the assignment yet, so we are all in the same boat.

In the sticks.definition: Ở vùng sâu vùng xa, nơi hẻo lánh.
In the sticks.example: She moved to a small house in the sticks to get away from the city noise.

In the way.example: He always feels like his big sister is in the way when he's trying to concentrate.

It ain't over till the fat lady sings.definition: Chưa đến phút cuối thì chưa biết kết quả ra sao (30 chưa phải là Tết).
It ain't over till the fat lady sings.example: Don't be discouraged by the score; it ain't over till the fat lady sings.

It is a poor workman who blames his tool.definition: Thợ tồi thì đổ lỗi cho đồ nghề.
It is a poor workman who blames his tool.example: Sarah was frustrated with her old paintbrushes, but her teacher reminded her that it's a poor workman who blames his tools.

It is always darkest before the dawn.definition: Cơn bĩ cực qua đi, hồi thái lai sẽ đến (mọi việc thường trở nên tồi tệ nhất trước khi tốt đẹp lên).
It is always darkest before the dawn.example: Remember, it's always darkest before the dawn; things will get better soon.

It takes one to know one.definition: Ngưu tầm ngưu, mã tầm mã; tự nhận mình cũng thế mới đi chê người khác.
It takes one to know one.example: It takes one to know one, my friend.

It takes two to tango.definition: Có lửa mới có khói; cả hai bên đều phải chịu trách nhiệm cho sự việc.
It takes two to tango.example: Don't blame just one person for the argument; it takes two to tango.

It's in the bag.definition: Chắc ăn, nắm chắc phần thắng trong tay.
It's in the bag.example: Once he scored the third goal, the victory was in the bag.

Itchy feet.definition: Ngứa ngáy tay chân, khao khát được đi du lịch hoặc chuyển đến nơi khác.
Itchy feet.example: She's had itchy feet ever since she got back from Europe and keeps talking about her next trip.

Ivory tower.definition: Tháp ngà (nơi sống tách biệt với thực tế xã hội, thường ám chỉ giới học thuật).
Ivory tower.example: Many people think professors live in an ivory tower, disconnected from the real world.

Jaywalking.definition: Hành vi qua đường ẩu, không đúng nơi quy định hoặc vượt đèn đỏ.
Jaywalking.example: He got a ticket for jaywalking across the busy street.

Johnny-come-lately.definition: Người mới đến, kẻ chân ướt chân ráo nhưng lại muốn được ưu ái như người cũ.
Johnny-come-lately.example: The team doesn't take kindly to a Johnny-come-lately giving suggestions.

Joined at the hip.definition: Dính lấy nhau như hình với bóng.
Joined at the hip.example: Ever since they started dating, they've been joined at the hip.

Josh someone.definition: Nói đùa, trêu chọc ai đó một cách vui vẻ.
Josh someone.example: Are you joshing me? There's no way you finished that project in one day.

Jump down someone's throat.definition: Nổi trận lôi đình, mắng nhiếc ai đó té tát và vô cớ.
Jump down someone's throat.example: He made a small mistake and she jumped down his throat.

jump for joy.definition: Nhảy cẫng lên vì sung sướng.
jump for joy.example: The team jumped for joy when the final whistle blew and they won the championship.

Jump on the bandwagon.definition: Hùa theo phong trào, chạy theo xu hướng đang thịnh hành.
Jump on the bandwagon.example: After the new show became a big hit, everyone seemed to jump on the bandwagon.

Jump the gun.definition: Cầm đèn chạy trước ô tô, hấp tấp làm việc gì đó quá sớm.
Jump the gun.example: She jumped the gun by submitting her application before getting all the necessary documents.

Jump through hoops.definition: Vượt qua nhiều rào cản, thủ tục rườm rà để đạt được mục đích.
Jump through hoops.example: She had to jump through a lot of hoops to get her visa approved.

Junk food.definition: Đồ ăn vặt, thức ăn nhanh có hại cho sức khỏe (ít dinh dưỡng, nhiều calo).
Junk food.example: Try to avoid eating too much junk food and focus on healthier options.

Just a moment.definition: Chờ một lát, xin đợi một chút.
Just a moment.example: Just a moment, I'll be right with you.

Just around the corner.definition: Sắp tới rồi, rất gần (về mặt thời gian hoặc khoảng cách).
Just around the corner.example: With the deadline just around the corner, everyone's working overtime.

Just now.definition: Vừa mới đây, cách đây một lát.
Just now.example: She called me just now to inform me of the meeting.

Keep an eye on.example: Can you keep an eye on the baby while I cook dinner?

keep at bay.definition: Ngăn chặn, kìm hãm mối nguy hiểm ở khoảng cách an toàn.
keep at bay.example: Drinking citrus juice and getting enough sleep helps keep common colds at bay.

Keep body and soul together.definition: Cố gắng cầm cự để sống sót, kiếm vừa đủ ăn để sống qua ngày.
Keep body and soul together.example: With his low wages, he can only just keep body and soul together.

keep in mind.definition: Ghi nhớ trong đầu, lưu tâm khi ra quyết định.
keep in mind.example: Keep in mind that stores close early on national holidays.

Keep one's chin up.definition: Giữ tinh thần lạc quan, đừng nản chí.
Keep one's chin up.example: Even though times are tough, try to keep your chin up.

Keep one's cool.definition: Giữ bình tĩnh, không nổi nóng trong những tình huống căng thẳng.
Keep one's cool.example: It's important to keep your cool in stressful situations at work.

Keep one's head.example: In the chaotic meeting, he was the only one who managed to keep his head.

Keep one's head above water.definition: Cố gắng xoay xở để không bị ngập trong nợ nần hoặc khó khăn.
Keep one's head above water.example: Ever since losing my job, I've been struggling to keep my head above water.

Keep one's mouth shut.definition: Giữ im lặng, không nói ra.
Keep one's mouth shut.example: If you know what's good for you, you'll keep your mouth shut about this.

Keep one's nose clean.definition: Tránh rắc rối, cư xử đúng mực.
Keep one's nose clean.example: If you want to stay out of trouble, you better keep your nose clean.

Keep one's nose to the grindstone.definition: Làm việc chăm chỉ, cặm cụi làm việc.
Keep one's nose to the grindstone.example: If you want to succeed, you have to keep your nose to the grindstone.

keep one's temper.definition: Giữ bình tĩnh, kìm nén cơn giận.
keep one's temper.example: It was difficult, but she managed to keep her temper during the heated argument.

Keep one's wits about one.definition: Giữ tỉnh táo và cảnh giác.
Keep one's wits about one.example: When walking through a crowded market, you need to keep your wits about you.

Keep someone at arm's length.definition: Giữ khoảng cách với ai đó.
Keep someone at arm's length.example: She's been keeping her coworkers at arm's length since her promotion.

Keep someone in the dark.definition: Giữ ai đó trong sự thiếu hiểu biết, giấu giếm ai đó.
Keep someone in the dark.example: The employees were kept in the dark about the company's merger plans.

Keep someone posted.definition: Cập nhật thông tin cho ai đó.
Keep someone posted.example: I'll keep you posted on any new developments.

Keep someone posted / Keep someone in th.definition: Cập nhật tình hình cho ai đó, giữ cho họ nắm bắt được thông tin.
Keep someone posted / Keep someone in th.example: Please keep me posted on any changes to the schedule.

Keep something at bay.definition: Ngăn chặn, kiểm soát điều gì đó xấu.
Keep something at bay.example: Regular exercise can help to keep stress at bay.

Keep something under control.definition: Kiểm soát tình hình, không để mọi chuyện vượt quá tầm kiểm soát.
Keep something under control.example: It's important to keep it under control during an emergency.

Keep something under one's hat.definition: Giữ bí mật điều gì đó.
Keep something under one's hat.example: I have some exciting news, but you gotta keep it under your hat for now.

Keep something under wraps.definition: Giữ bí mật về chuyện gì đó, không tiết lộ ra ngoài.
Keep something under wraps.example: They decided to keep it under wraps until the official announcement.

keep tabs on.definition: Theo dõi sát sao, để mắt canh chừng ai/cái gì.
keep tabs on.example: The manager keeps close tabs on stock levels to prevent inventory shortages.

Keep the ball rolling.definition: Duy trì sự tiến triển của một việc gì đó.
Keep the ball rolling.example: We need to keep the ball rolling on this project to meet the deadline.

Keep up with.example: It's hard to keep up with the latest technology trends.

Keep up with the Joneses.definition: Đua đòi, cố gắng bằng bạn bằng bè.
Keep up with the Joneses.example: They're always keeping up with the Joneses, trying to buy every new gadget their neighbors get.

keep your chin up.definition: Hãy lạc quan lên, đừng nản lòng, ngẩng cao đầu.
keep your chin up.example: Keep your chin up; you will do much better on the next interview.

Keyed up.definition: Căng thẳng, hồi hộp hoặc phấn khích.
Keyed up.example: She was all keyed up before her big presentation.

Kick up one's heels.example: After finishing the project, they decided to kick up their heels and throw a big party.

Kill the mood.definition: Làm mất vui, phá hỏng bầu không khí.
Kill the mood.example: His rude comment killed the mood at the party.

kill time.definition: Giết thời gian, tiêu khiển trong lúc chờ đợi.
kill time.example: We browsed books at the airport bookstore to kill time before boarding our flight.

Kill two birds with one stone.definition: Một mũi tên trúng hai đích, một công đôi việc.
Kill two birds with one stone.example: By carpooling, we can kill two birds with one stone — save money on gas and reduce our carbon footprint.

Kit and caboodle.definition: Toàn bộ, tất cả mọi thứ.
Kit and caboodle.example: I just bought a new computer, mouse, keyboard, and the whole kit and caboodle.

Knee-high to a grasshopper.definition: Còn rất nhỏ, còn bé xíu.
Knee-high to a grasshopper.example: I've known her since she was knee-high to a grasshopper.

Knee-jerk reaction.definition: Phản xạ tự nhiên, phản ứng thiếu suy nghĩ.
Knee-jerk reaction.example: Instead of having a knee-jerk reaction, take a moment to think it through.

Knock it off.example: Hey, knock it off! I'm trying to concentrate.

Knock on wood.definition: Trộm vía (mong điều tốt đẹp hoặc tránh xui xẻo).
Knock on wood.example: I've never gotten a speeding ticket, knock on wood.

Knock someone's socks off.definition: Gây ấn tượng mạnh mẽ với ai đó.
Knock someone's socks off.example: Her presentation knocked everyone's socks off at the meeting.

Knock something into a cocked hat.definition: Đánh bại hoàn toàn, phá hỏng hoàn toàn.
Knock something into a cocked hat.example: The new evidence knocked their theory into a cocked hat.

Know by sight.example: I know him by sight, but we've never talked.

Know one's onions.definition: Rành rẽ, am hiểu tường tận.
Know one's onions.example: When it comes to digital marketing, she really knows her onions.

know someone inside out.definition: Hiểu ai tường tận từ trong ra ngoài, hiểu thấu tâm can ai.
know someone inside out.example: They have been best friends since childhood, so they know each other inside out.

Know the ins and outs.definition: Nắm rõ ngọn ngành, biết tường tận.
Know the ins and outs.example: She knows the ins and outs of the company's policy.

Know the ropes.definition: Nắm vững tình hình, biết cách làm việc.
Know the ropes.example: After a few weeks on the job, you'll start to know the ropes.

Know which way the wind is blowing.definition: Nắm bắt tình hình, biết gió chiều nào che chiều ấy.
Know which way the wind is blowing.example: Before making any big decisions, it's important to know which way the wind is blowing in the market.

Know zip.example: I know zip about repairing cars.

Knuckle under.example: After hours of negotiation, he finally had to knuckle under and agree to the terms.

Labor of love.definition: Công việc làm vì đam mê.
Labor of love.example: Writing her novel was a labor of love; she spent years perfecting it.

Last but not least.definition: Cuối cùng nhưng không kém phần quan trọng.
Last but not least.example: And last but not least, I'd like to thank all the volunteers for their hard work.

last straw.definition: Giọt nước tràn ly, điều cuối cùng khiến sự chịu đựng bùng nổ.
last straw.example: When he arrived two hours late again, it was the last straw and she fired him.

Last-ditch effort.definition: Nỗ lực cuối cùng, cố gắng vớt vát.
Last-ditch effort.example: In a last-ditch effort to save their home, they organized a fundraising event.

Laugh all the way to the bank.definition: Kiếm được món hời lớn một cách dễ dàng.
Laugh all the way to the bank.example: After selling his startup, he was laughing all the way to the bank.

Lay an egg.definition: Thất bại thảm hại (thường trong biểu diễn hoặc ra mắt).
Lay an egg.example: The new product launch laid an egg; customers were not interested.

Lay down the law.definition: Đặt ra luật lệ, ra oai.
Lay down the law.example: The boss had to lay down the law after too many employees started arriving late.

Lay someone off.definition: Sa thải (vì lý do kinh tế, tổ chức lại).
Lay someone off.example: He was laid off last month because the company had to downsize.

Lead someone around by the nose.definition: Xỏ mũi ai đó, dắt mũi ai đó.
Lead someone around by the nose.example: Don't let your boss lead you around by the nose; stand up for yourself.

learn by heart.example: The students were required to learn the entire poem by heart.

Learn by rote.definition: Học vẹt, học thuộc lòng một cách máy móc.
Learn by rote.example: Students often learn mathematical formulas by rote without understanding the concepts.

Learn one's lesson.definition: Rút ra bài học, chừa đến già.
Learn one's lesson.example: After forgetting my ID, I learned my lesson and always double-check my bag before leaving.

Learn the ropes.definition: Học việc, làm quen với công việc.
Learn the ropes.example: It will take a few weeks for the new intern to learn the ropes.

Leave no stone unturned.definition: Thử mọi cách, lật tung mọi thứ.
Leave no stone unturned.example: The detectives promised to leave no stone unturned in their search for the missing girl.

Leave someone alone.example: I need some time to think, so please leave me alone.

Leave someone high and dry.definition: Bỏ mặc ai đó trong lúc khó khăn.
Leave someone high and dry.example: He promised to help, but then he left me high and dry.

Leave someone in the lurch.definition: Bỏ rơi ai đó trong lúc hoạn nạn.
Leave someone in the lurch.example: Just when I needed help most, he left me in the lurch.

Leave someone out in the cold.definition: Ngó lơ ai đó, cho ai đó ra rìa.
Leave someone out in the cold.example: When the team decided to go ahead without him, he was left out in the cold.

Leave well enough alone.definition: Tránh chữa lợn lành thành lợn què, cứ để yên mọi chuyện.
Leave well enough alone.example: The project is going smoothly, so let's just leave well enough alone.

Left behind.definition: Bỏ lại phía sau, bỏ rơi.
Left behind.example: When they promoted the other employees, they left Mark behind.

Lend a hand.example: Could you lend me a hand with these groceries?

Lend an ear.definition: Lắng nghe, chú ý lắng nghe.
Lend an ear.example: Could you lend me your ear for a moment? I need to talk about something important.

let by-gones be by-gones.definition: Chuyện gì qua hãy để nó qua, bỏ qua chuyện cũ.
let by-gones be by-gones.example: They decided to let bygones be bygones and rebuild their long friendship.

Let bygones be bygones.definition: Hãy để quá khứ ngủ yên, bỏ qua chuyện cũ.
Let bygones be bygones.example: After their argument, they decided to let bygones be bygones and move on.

Let sleeping dogs lie.definition: Đừng bới bèo ra bọ, để mọi chuyện yên ổn.
Let sleeping dogs lie.example: Let's not bring up that old argument again; it's better to just let sleeping dogs lie.

Let someone off the hook.definition: Tha lỗi cho ai đó, giải thoát ai đó khỏi trách nhiệm hoặc rắc rối.
Let someone off the hook.example: The teacher let him off the hook despite missing his homework.

Let the cat out of the bag.definition: Vô tình để lộ bí mật.
Let the cat out of the bag.example: Oops, I think I just let the cat out of the bag about her surprise party.

Let the dust settle.definition: Chờ cho mọi việc lắng xuống.
Let the dust settle.example: Let's just wait for a while and let the dust settle before making any big decisions.

Let your hair down.example: After a long week of work, it's important to just let your hair down on the weekend.

Letter-perfect.definition: Hoàn hảo, không sai một chữ.
Letter-perfect.example: Her presentation was letter-perfect and impressed everyone in the meeting.

Like a chicken with its head cut off.definition: Lăng xăng, cuống cuồng như gà mắc tóc.
Like a chicken with its head cut off.example: He was running around like a chicken with its head cut off, trying to get everything ready for the party.

Like a deer in the headlights.definition: Chết trân, sững sờ (vì sợ hãi hoặc bất ngờ).
Like a deer in the headlights.example: Caught off guard by the news, she stood there like a deer in the headlights.

Like clockwork.definition: Đều đặn, trơn tru như một cái máy.
Like clockwork.example: The train arrives at the station like clockwork every morning.

like father like son.definition: Cha nào con nấy, hổ phụ sinh hổ tử.
like father like son.example: He has the same sharp business sense as his dad—like father, like son!

Like nailing jello to a wall.definition: Khó như mò kim đáy bể, việc bất khả thi.
Like nailing jello to a wall.example: Getting my toddler to sit still is like nailing jello to a wall.

Like pulling teeth.definition: Khó khăn, cực nhọc (đặc biệt khi thuyết phục ai).
Like pulling teeth.example: Getting a straight answer from him is like pulling teeth.

Like riding a bike.definition: Dễ như đi xe đạp, học một lần nhớ mãi.
Like riding a bike.example: Programming is like riding a bike; you'll quickly get back into it.

Like taking candy from a baby.definition: Dễ như ăn kẹo, dễ như trở bàn tay.
Like taking candy from a baby.example: For a professional chef, making this dish is like taking candy from a baby.

Like there's no tomorrow.definition: (Làm gì đó) như không có ngày mai, hết mình.
Like there's no tomorrow.example: They were spending money like there's no tomorrow during their vacation.

Like water off a duck's back.example: When they make fun of him, it's like water off a duck's back; he doesn't take it to heart.

Live and learn.definition: Đi một ngày đàng học một sàng khôn, sống qua mới biết.
Live and learn.example: You thought you could fix the car yourself, but it broke down again. Live and learn.

Live and let live.definition: Sống và để người khác sống, tôn trọng sự khác biệt.
Live and let live.example: I don't always agree with my neighbors, but I believe in live and let live.

Live beyond your means.definition: Tiêu xài hoang phí, vung tay quá trán.
Live beyond your means.example: If you live beyond your means, you might end up in serious debt.

Live hand-to-mouth.definition: Sống chật vật qua ngày, kiếm đồng nào xào đồng ấy.
Live hand-to-mouth.example: After losing his job, he had to live hand-to-mouth.

Live it up.definition: Sống hết mình, ăn chơi xả láng.
Live it up.example: After winning the lottery, he decided to live it up and travel the world.

live paycheck to paycheck.definition: Sống chật vật qua ngày (lĩnh lương tháng nào tiêu hết tháng đó, không dư dả).
live paycheck to paycheck.example: With rising rent and inflation, many young workers are forced to live paycheck to paycheck.

Living the dream.example: Ever since he moved to Los Angeles to pursue acting, he's been living the dream.

Lock, stock, and barrel.definition: Toàn bộ, không thiếu thứ gì.
Lock, stock, and barrel.example: They sold the business lock, stock, and barrel to a new owner.

Long in the tooth.example: That computer model is getting a bit long in the tooth; it's time for an upgrade.

Long time no see.example: Long time no see! How have you been?

Look before you leap.definition: Phải suy nghĩ cẩn thận trước khi hành động, cẩn tắc vô áy náy.
Look before you leap.example: Before quitting your job, remember to look before you leap.

Look down one's nose.definition: Khinh khỉnh, coi thường người khác.
Look down one's nose.example: She tends to look down her nose at people who don't dress as well as she does.

look high and low.definition: Tìm kiếm khắp nơi, lùng sục mọi xó xỉnh.
look high and low.example: I looked high and low for my car keys before finding them in my coat pocket.

Look like a million bucks.definition: Trông rất tuyệt vời, lộng lẫy.
Look like a million bucks.example: You look like a million bucks in that dress!

look like death warmed over.definition: Trông như xác chết trôi, phờ phạc rũ rượi.
look like death warmed over.example: You should go see a doctor; you look like death warmed over.

Look like the cat that got the cream.definition: Trông vô cùng mãn nguyện, đắc ý.
Look like the cat that got the cream.example: When she won the game, she looked like the cat that got the cream.

look on the bright side.definition: Nhìn vào mặt tích cực, lạc quan.
look on the bright side.example: Look on the bright side: at least the delay gave us time to finish our homework.

look the other way.definition: Làm ngơ, quay mặt đi giả vờ không thấy chuyện xấu.
look the other way.example: Corrupt officials chose to look the other way while illegal dumping occurred.

Lose one's head.definition: Mất bình tĩnh, mất kiểm soát.
Lose one's head.example: I'm sorry I shouted at you; I just lost my head for a moment.

Lose one's marbles.example: She's been so stressed she feels like she's losing her marbles.

Lose one's shirt.example: Invest carefully, or you might lose your shirt in the stock market.

Lose one's touch.example: I can't seem to bake cookies like I used to; I must have lost my touch.

Lose touch.definition: Mất liên lạc, mất kết nối.
Lose touch.example: We used to be close friends, but we lost touch after college.

Lost at sea.example: Without proper guidance, many new employees feel lost at sea in their first week.

Low-hanging fruit.definition: Mục tiêu dễ đạt được, việc dễ xơi.
Low-hanging fruit.example: Let's focus on the low-hanging fruit before tackling the bigger issues.

Luck out.example: We really lucked out with the weather during our trip.

Mad as a hornet.definition: Giận điên người, tức giận sôi máu.
Mad as a hornet.example: He was mad as a hornet when he found out someone had scratched his new car.

Made for each other.definition: Sinh ra là để cho nhau, tâm đầu ý hợp.
Made for each other.example: The way they understand each other makes it clear they are truly made for each other.

Make a beeline for.definition: Đi thẳng tới, lao thẳng đến.
Make a beeline for.example: As soon as the meeting was over, she made a beeline for the exit.

Make a big stink.definition: Làm ầm lên, phàn nàn rùm beng.
Make a big stink.example: She made a big stink when her order was wrong, insisting on speaking to the manager.

Make a long story short.definition: Nói tóm lại, tóm gọn lại.
Make a long story short.example: To make a long story short, we missed the flight but managed to get another one.

Make a mountain out of a molehill.example: Don't make a mountain out of a molehill; it's just a minor mistake.

Make a pit stop.definition: Dừng chân nghỉ ngơi (giữa chuyến đi).
Make a pit stop.example: We need to make a pit stop at the next gas station for a bathroom break.

make a point of.definition: Để tâm, coi trọng và chú ý đặc biệt làm việc gì.
make a point of.example: He always makes a point of thanking each team member individually.

Make a scene.example: Please don’t make a scene at the restaurant; let’s talk about it later.

Make ends meet.definition: Kiếm đủ sống; xoay xở đủ chi tiêu.
Make ends meet.example: Many families struggle to make ends meet in today’s economy.

Make eyes at someone.definition: Liếc mắt đưa tình; nhìn đắm đuối.
Make eyes at someone.example: I saw him making eyes at her during the meeting.

Make hay while the sun shines.example: You should apply for the job now before the position gets filled. Make hay while the sun shines.

make heads or tails of.definition: Hiểu đầu cua tai nheo gì (thường dùng ở dạng phủ định).
make heads or tails of.example: I cannot make heads or tails of these complicated tax forms.

Make matters worse.definition: Làm cho mọi chuyện tồi tệ hơn, họa vô đơn chí.
Make matters worse.example: We were caught in the rain, and to make matters worse, the car broke down.

Make no bones about.definition: Thẳng thắn; không ngần ngại giấu giếm.
Make no bones about.example: She made no bones about her decision to leave the company.

Make one's hair stand on end.definition: Dựng tóc gáy, vô cùng sợ hãi.
Make one's hair stand on end.example: The horror movie I watched last night made my hair stand on end.

Make out like a bandit.definition: Trúng quả đậm; kiếm được bộn tiền.
Make out like a bandit.example: He made out like a bandit with the stock sale.

Make out what someone says.definition: Nghe rõ; hiểu được lời ai đó.
Make out what someone says.example: I couldn’t make out what he said over the phone because of the poor connection.

Make the grade.definition: Đạt tiêu chuẩn; đủ điều kiện.
Make the grade.example: She studied hard to make the grade in her final exams.

Make tracks.definition: Rời đi gấp gáp; chuồn nhanh.
Make tracks.example: We need to make tracks if we want to catch the last train.

make up for lost time.definition: Bù đắp lại khoảng thời gian đã mất.
make up for lost time.example: Having not seen each other for years, the childhood friends talked all night to make up for lost time.

make up one's mind.definition: Quyết định, đưa ra lựa chọn dứt khoát.
make up one's mind.example: She could not make up her mind about which university degree to pursue.

make up your mind.definition: Đưa ra quyết định, dứt khoát quyết định.
make up your mind.example: You need to make up your mind about which university course to attend.

Make waves.definition: Gây sóng gió; tạo sự chú ý.
Make waves.example: Her controversial speech really made waves among the community.

Make yourself at home.definition: Cứ tự nhiên như ở nhà nhé.
Make yourself at home.example: Please, make yourself at home. There’s no need to be formal.

Man's best friend.definition: Người bạn tốt nhất của con người (thường chỉ chó).
Man's best friend.example: Dogs are often called man’s best friend because they are so loyal.

Mark time.definition: Dậm chân tại chỗ; chờ thời.
Mark time.example: I’ve been marking time at this job until I find something better.

match made in heaven.definition: Cặp đôi trời sinh, sự kết hợp hoàn hảo.
match made in heaven.example: They share identical values and hobbies; they are truly a match made in heaven.

Meat and potatoes.definition: Phần cốt lõi; phần cơ bản và quan trọng nhất.
Meat and potatoes.example: The meat and potatoes of the project involve data analysis and reporting.

Meet halfway.example: Let’s meet halfway on this issue and find a solution that works for both of us.

Mickey Mouse job.definition: Công việc nhàn hạ, lặt vặt (không quan trọng).
Mickey Mouse job.example: I don’t want a Mickey Mouse job; I want something with real responsibility.

Midas touch.definition: Bàn tay vàng (khả năng làm đâu thắng đó).
Midas touch.example: He seems to have the Midas touch; every business he starts becomes a success.

Middle of the road.definition: Ở mức trung bình; không có gì nổi trội.
Middle of the road.example: The band’s new album is pretty middle of the road; it’s okay, but nothing special.

Mind your own beeswax.definition: Lo chuyện của mình đi; đừng chúi mũi vào chuyện người khác.
Mind your own beeswax.example: When he kept asking about my personal life, I told him to mind his own beeswax.

Miss the boat.example: If we don’t act now, we might miss the boat on this great deal.

Mom-and-pop.definition: (Cửa hàng) kinh doanh nhỏ lẻ theo hộ gia đình.
Mom-and-pop.example: They decided to open a mom-and-pop grocery store in their neighborhood.

Money burns a hole in someone's pocket.definition: Có tiền là tiêu liền; không giữ được tiền.
Money burns a hole in someone's pocket.example: As soon as he gets his paycheck, it’s gone. Money burns a hole in his pocket.

money doesn't grow on trees.definition: Tiền bạc không phải là vỏ hến (tiền không tự nhiên sinh ra trên cây).
money doesn't grow on trees.example: Stop wasting your allowance on useless gadgets; money doesn't grow on trees!

Money talks.definition: Đồng tiền có sức mạnh; có tiền mua tiên cũng được.
Money talks.example: When it comes to getting things done, money talks.

Money to burn.definition: Tiền xài không hết; rủng rỉnh tiền bạc.
Money to burn.example: Ever since he won the lottery, he’s had money to burn.

More bang for your buck.example: This restaurant gives you more bang for your buck compared to others in the area.

More than meets the eye.definition: Phức tạp hơn vẻ bề ngoài; ẩn chứa nhiều điều bên trong.
More than meets the eye.example: The case seems simple, but there’s more than meets the eye.

More than one bargained for.definition: Nằm ngoài dự kiến; rắc rối hơn dự tính.
More than one bargained for.example: The new project turned out to be more than I bargained for.

mother nature.definition: Mẹ thiên nhiên, mẹ tạo hóa.
mother nature.example: Human beings must learn to respect Mother Nature before climate change gets worse.

Move some things around.definition: Thay đổi lịch trình; sắp xếp lại kế hoạch.
Move some things around.example: I need to move some things around to fit in the meeting tomorrow.

Mum's the word.example: Remember, mum’s the word about the surprise party.

Mumbo jumbo.definition: Lới nói lảm nhảm; biệt ngữ khó hiểu.
Mumbo jumbo.example: All this technical mumbo jumbo is hard to understand.

My bad.example: I forgot to bring the tickets. My bad.

Nest egg.definition: Khoản tiền tiết kiệm phòng thân.
Nest egg.example: She’s been saving a nest egg for her retirement.

Never bite the hand that feeds you.definition: Đừng ăn cháo đá bát; đừng vong ơn bội nghĩa.
Never bite the hand that feeds you.example: He lost his job because he didn’t follow the rule: never bite the hand that feeds you.

never mind.definition: Đừng bận tâm, không sao đâu, bỏ qua đi.
never mind.example: If you cannot find my notebook, never mind; I have an extra one.

New kid on the block.example: As the new kid on the block, she felt a bit overwhelmed at first.

New York minute.definition: Trong chớp mắt; một khoảnh khắc rất ngắn.
New York minute.example: In a New York minute, the deal was closed and they were out the door.

Night owl.example: I’ve always been a night owl, I get my best work done after midnight.

Nip something in the bud.definition: Ngăn chặn từ đầu; dập tắt từ trong trứng nước.
Nip something in the bud.example: We need to nip this problem in the bud before it gets out of control.

Nitty-gritty.definition: Điểm mấu chốt; chi tiết cốt lõi.
Nitty-gritty.example: Let’s get down to the nitty-gritty of the project and figure out what needs to be done.

Nix something.definition: Hủy bỏ, bác bỏ, từ chối.
Nix something.example: The manager decided to nix the project due to budget constraints.

No big deal.definition: Chuyện nhỏ; không có gì to tát.
No big deal.example: Don’t worry about the mistake; it’s no big deal.

No dice.example: I asked for a raise, but no dice.

No pain, no gain.definition: Có làm thì mới có ăn; không đổ mồ hôi, không có thành quả.
No pain, no gain.example: If you want to get fit, remember: No pain, no gain.

No rhyme or reason.definition: Không có lý do gì cả; chẳng có quy luật nào.
No rhyme or reason.example: There is no rhyme or reason to the way he organizes his desk.

No skin off one's nose.definition: Chẳng ảnh hưởng gì đến tôi cả, tôi không bận tâm.
No skin off one's nose.example: If he wants to leave the team, it's no skin off my nose.

No-brainer.definition: Quyết định dễ dàng; chuyện hiển nhiên.
No-brainer.example: Accepting that job offer was a no-brainer for me.

Not a spark of decency.definition: Bất lịch sự; không có chút ý tứ nào.
Not a spark of decency.example: He shouted at the waiter and showed not a spark of decency.

Not have a leg to stand on.definition: Không có lý lẽ vững chắc; không có bằng chứng, căn cứ để bào chữa hay chứng minh (trong một cuộc tranh luận).
Not have a leg to stand on.example: Without any proof, his accusations really don't have a leg to stand on.

Not one's cup of tea.definition: Không phải sở thích của ai đó; không phải thứ ai đó quan tâm hay thích thú.
Not one's cup of tea.example: Thank you for the invitation, but horror movies are not my cup of tea.

Not playing with a full deck.definition: Thiếu thông minh, chập mạch, không bình thường.
Not playing with a full deck.example: After hearing his bizarre theory, I started to think he’s not playing with a full deck.

Not rocket science.definition: Chẳng có gì phức tạp cả, không khó hiểu đâu.
Not rocket science.example: I don't understand why you're so confused; filing taxes isn't rocket science.

Not what it's cracked up to be.definition: Không tốt như lời đồn; không giống như những gì được tâng bốc.
Not what it's cracked up to be.example: The new restaurant is not what it's cracked up to be; the food was mediocre at best.

Not worth a red cent.definition: Hoàn toàn vô giá trị; không đáng một xu.
Not worth a red cent.example: This old phone is not worth a red cent.

Nothing to write home about.definition: Bình thường, không có gì đặc sắc; không có gì đáng nói.
Nothing to write home about.example: The restaurant was okay, but the food was nothing to write home about.

nuclear family.definition: Gia đình hạt nhân (gia đình chỉ gồm cha mẹ và con cái).
nuclear family.example: Modern urban society is largely built around the nuclear family structure.

Number cruncher.definition: Người chuyên làm việc với các con số; chuyên gia xử lý và phân tích dữ liệu số liệu.
Number cruncher.example: You need to be a good number cruncher to excel in a finance career.

Odd man out.definition: Người hoặc vật lạc lõng, khác biệt so với phần còn lại của nhóm.
Odd man out.example: He felt like the odd man out at the party because he didn't know anyone.

off color.definition: Sắc mặt nhợt nhạt, trông có vẻ không được khỏe.
off color.example: You look a bit off color today; are you coming down with a flu?

Off on the wrong foot.definition: Bắt đầu một cách tồi tệ; có một sự khởi đầu không suôn sẻ (đặc biệt trong một mối quan hệ).
Off on the wrong foot.example: They got off on the wrong foot during their first meeting and have been at odds since.

Off one's rocker.definition: Bị điên, dở hơi, mất trí.
Off one's rocker.example: Don’t listen to him, he’s off his rocker.

Off the cuff.definition: Tùy cơ ứng biến; nói hoặc làm một việc gì đó tự phát, không có sự chuẩn bị trước.
Off the cuff.example: He gave an off-the-cuff speech that impressed everyone.

Off the hook.definition: Thoát khỏi trách nhiệm; thoát nạn hoặc không bị trừng phạt vì một lỗi lầm.
Off the hook.example: He thought he would get in trouble for the mistake, but his boss let him off the hook.

Off the record.definition: Không chính thức; giữ kín, không được ghi âm, ghi chép hay công bố.
Off the record.example: He made it clear that his comments were strictly off the record.

Off the top of my head.definition: Bật ra ngay trong đầu; theo những gì nhớ được ngay lúc này mà không cần suy nghĩ sâu xa hay kiểm tra lại.
Off the top of my head.example: I can't remember the exact date off the top of my head, but it was sometime in June.

Off the wall.definition: Kỳ quặc, khác thường; điên rồ nhưng đôi khi lại thú vị.
Off the wall.example: His idea for the project was completely off the wall, but it actually worked!

Off-color.definition: Khiếm nhã, thô tục; không phù hợp với chuẩn mực giao tiếp (thường chỉ những trò đùa cợt nhả).
Off-color.example: He was reprimanded for making an off-color joke in the office.

Old school.definition: Kiểu cũ, cổ điển; theo phong cách hoặc giữ những giá trị truyền thống từ thời xưa.
Old school.example: My grandfather is really old school; he doesn't trust modern technology.

On a shoestring.definition: Với ngân sách eo hẹp; làm gì đó với chi phí rất thấp.
On a shoestring.example: Starting a business on a shoestring is challenging but possible.

On a tear.definition: Đang trên đà chiến thắng; liên tục đạt được những thành công vang dội trong thời gian ngắn.
On a tear.example: The team has been on a tear lately, winning five games in a row.

On a treadmill.definition: Làm những việc lặp đi lặp lại một cách nhàm chán mà không thấy sự tiến triển; giậm chân tại chỗ.
On a treadmill.example: I feel like I'm just on a treadmill with these endless meetings and no real results.

On cloud nine.definition: Vô cùng hạnh phúc; sung sướng lâng lâng như trên chín tầng mây.
On cloud nine.example: She was on cloud nine after receiving the job offer.

on edge.definition: Bồn chồn lo lắng, đứng ngồi không yên, dễ cáu kỉnh.
on edge.example: Everyone in the office has been on edge while waiting for the company restructuring news.

On pins and needles.definition: Lo lắng, bồn chồn; cảm giác đứng ngồi không yên khi chờ đợi một điều gì đó.
On pins and needles.example: She was on pins and needles waiting for the job interview results.

On the ball.definition: Nhanh nhẹn, nhạy bén; phản ứng nhanh và xử lý tình huống tốt.
On the ball.example: She caught the mistake in the report right away; she's really on the ball.

On the blink.definition: Bị hỏng hóc, chập chờn; không hoạt động bình thường (thường dùng cho máy móc).
On the blink.example: The TV went on the blink just before the big game.

On the cheap.definition: Mua được với giá rẻ; làm việc gì đó với chi phí thấp nhất có thể.
On the cheap.example: They traveled across the country on the cheap by staying in hostels.

On the dot.definition: Đúng giờ; chính xác tại một thời điểm đã định, không trễ một phút.
On the dot.example: The meeting will start at 9 a.m. on the dot.

On the fence.definition: Đang lưỡng lự; chưa đưa ra quyết định hoặc không đứng về phía nào.
On the fence.example: She's still on the fence about which university to attend.

On the fly.definition: Tùy cơ ứng biến; đưa ra quyết định hoặc làm gì đó một cách nhanh chóng ngay tại thời điểm đó mà không có kế hoạch trước.
On the fly.example: We often have to solve problems on the fly at work.

On the fritz.definition: Bị hỏng hóc, dở chứng; thiết bị không hoạt động bình thường.
On the fritz.example: The coffee machine in the office is on the fritz.

On the house.definition: Miễn phí; được quán ăn, nhà hàng thiết đãi hoặc tặng (khách hàng không phải trả tiền).
On the house.example: The dessert is on the house tonight because it's our anniversary celebration.

On the level.definition: Trung thực, thẳng thắn; đáng tin cậy và không có ý đồ gian lận.
On the level.example: You can trust him; he's on the level.

On the line.definition: Bị đe dọa, gặp rủi ro; đang trong tình thế ngàn cân treo sợi tóc (danh tiếng, sự nghiệp, tính mạng).
On the line.example: His job is on the line after the recent mistakes.

on the mend.definition: Đang trên đà hồi phục, sức khỏe đang dần tiến triển tốt.
on the mend.example: Her fever has broken and she is finally on the mend.

on the rocks.definition: Rạn nứt, đứng trước bờ vực đổ vỡ (hôn nhân, quan hệ, kinh doanh).
on the rocks.example: Their marriage has been on the rocks for months due to poor communication.

On the same page.definition: Cùng chung quan điểm; hiểu ý nhau và nhất trí về một vấn đề.
On the same page.example: In order to ensure the project's success, we need to make sure everyone is on the same page.

On the same wavelength.definition: Bắt đúng tần số; Tâm đầu ý hợp
On the same wavelength.example: The new manager and I are on the same wavelength about the project goals.

On the spot.definition: Ngay lập tức, tại chỗ; bị đặt vào tình thế phải phản ứng hoặc quyết định ngay.
On the spot.example: He solved the problem on the spot without any help.

On the spur of the moment.definition: Hành động một cách bốc đồng; quyết định nhất thời, không suy tính trước.
On the spur of the moment.example: We decided to go on a trip on the spur of the moment.

On the up and up.definition: Trung thực, đàng hoàng; (hoặc) ngày càng trở nên tốt hơn, đang phát triển theo chiều hướng tốt.
On the up and up.example: Our business is on the up and up after the new investments.

On the warpath.definition: Đang trong cơn thịnh nộ; sẵn sàng gây hấn hoặc trút giận lên người khác.
On the warpath.example: Watch out, the boss is on the warpath today after the project failed.

On thin ice.definition: Ở trong tình thế rủi ro, nguy hiểm; như đi trên lớp băng mỏng (chỉ cần một sai lầm nhỏ cũng dẫn đến hậu quả lớn).
On thin ice.example: After missing several deadlines, John is really on thin ice with his boss.

On top of the world.definition: Cực kỳ hạnh phúc; cảm thấy như đang đứng trên đỉnh vinh quang.
On top of the world.example: After getting the job offer, she felt on top of the world.

Once and for all.definition: Một lần và mãi mãi; giải quyết triệt để vấn đề để không bao giờ phải bận tâm lại.
Once and for all.example: Let's settle this once and for all.

Once bitten, twice shy.definition: Chim phải đạn sợ cành cong; trở nên cẩn trọng, e dè sau khi đã trải qua một thất bại hoặc tổn thương.
Once bitten, twice shy.example: After getting scammed online, he is now once bitten, twice shy about shopping on unfamiliar websites.

Once in a blue moon.definition: Năm thì mười họa; hiếm khi xảy ra.
Once in a blue moon.example: He only visits us once in a blue moon, but it's always a great time when he does.

once upon a time.example: Once upon a time, there lived a humble woodcutter deep in an ancient enchanted forest.

One fell swoop.definition: Nhanh chóng trong một lần duy nhất; giải quyết gọn gàng trong một đợt.
One fell swoop.example: The company launched three new products in one fell swoop.

One-trick pony.definition: Người hoặc vật chỉ có một tài năng, kỹ năng duy nhất; người chỉ giỏi một thứ mà không có sự linh hoạt.
One-trick pony.example: Some critics say that he's just a one-trick pony, only good at drama roles.

One's eyes are bigger than one's stomach.example: I thought I could finish the whole pizza, but my eyes were bigger than my stomach.

One's hands are tied.definition: Bó tay; không thể làm gì được.
One's hands are tied.example: I’d love to help, but my hands are tied due to company policy.

One's neck of the woods.definition: Khu vực ai đó sinh sống.
One's neck of the woods.example: Why don’t you come over to my neck of the woods this weekend?

Open a can of worms.definition: Rước họa vào thân; gây ra những rắc rối mới phức tạp khi cố giải quyết một vấn đề.
Open a can of worms.example: Changing the project scope right now would open a can of worms.

Out of date.definition: Lỗi thời, cũ rích; không còn theo kịp xu hướng hoặc không còn được áp dụng.
Out of date.example: Using paper maps is pretty out of date now that we have GPS.

Out of left field.definition: Bất thình lình, bất ngờ; đến từ nơi không ai lường trước được.
Out of left field.example: The new policy was completely out of left field and surprised everyone.

Out of my hands.definition: Nằm ngoài tầm kiểm soát; không thuộc quyền quyết định hay trách nhiệm của mình nữa.
Out of my hands.example: The decision is out of my hands; it's up to the management now.

Out of order.definition: Bị hỏng, trục trặc (máy móc); hoặc cư xử không đúng mực.
Out of order.example: The elevator is out of order, so you'll have to take the stairs.

out of shape.definition: Thân hình mất cân đối, thể lực kém (do lười vận động).
out of shape.example: I got winded climbing just two flights of stairs—I am really out of shape.

out of sorts.definition: Khó ở, cảm thấy không khỏe hoặc ủ rũ khó chịu.
out of sorts.example: He has been out of sorts all morning because he did not get enough sleep.

Out of the blue.definition: Bất thình lình; hoàn toàn bất ngờ mà không có dấu hiệu báo trước.
Out of the blue.example: He called me out of the blue after five years of no contact.

Out of the frying pan and into the fire.definition: Tránh vỏ dưa gặp vỏ dừa; thoát khỏi một hoàn cảnh khó khăn này lại rơi vào một hoàn cảnh tồi tệ hơn.
Out of the frying pan and into the fire.example: Leaving the bad restaurant, we ended up in a place even worse. Talk about out of the frying pan and into the fire.

Out of the question.definition: Không thể được, không đáng bàn tới.
Out of the question.example: Traveling abroad this year is out of the question given our budget.

Out of the woods.definition: Thoát khỏi nguy hiểm, qua cơn nguy kịch.
Out of the woods.example: After months of treatment, the doctors finally said he was out of the woods.

Out of this world.definition: Tuyệt vời ông mặt trời, xuất sắc.
Out of this world.example: The food at that restaurant is out of this world.

Out on the town.definition: Đi chơi đêm, ăn chơi xả láng trên phố.
Out on the town.example: We’re going out on the town to celebrate my birthday tonight.

Out to lunch.definition: Mơ màng, mất tập trung, đầu óc trên mây.
Out to lunch.example: During the meeting, he seemed completely out to lunch.

Outdo oneself.definition: Vượt lên chính mình, làm tốt hơn mong đợi.
Outdo oneself.example: She really outdid herself with this year's presentation.

Over my dead body.definition: Bước qua xác tôi trước đã, không bao giờ.
Over my dead body.example: You want to drop out of school? Over my dead body.

over the moon.definition: Vui sướng tột cùng, ngập tràn hạnh phúc.

Throw someone for a loop.definition: Làm ai đó bất ngờ; Gây sốc

Throw someone to the wolves.definition: Bị bỏ mặc cho chết; Bị đẩy vào chỗ chết
Throw someone to the wolves.example: She felt like she was thrown to the wolves when she had to present in front of the entire board.

Tickled pink.definition: Vui như mở cờ trong bụng
Tickled pink.example: She was tickled pink when she found out she had won the contest.

tie the knot.definition: Kết hôn, nên duyên vợ chồng, làm đám cưới.
tie the knot.example: After dating for seven years, they finally decided to tie the knot this autumn.

tied to mother's apron strings.definition: Bám váy mẹ, quá phụ thuộc vào mẹ.
tied to mother's apron strings.example: Even in his thirties, he is still tied to his mother's apron strings.

Tighten your belt.example: The company is going through a slow season, so there will be some belt-tightening measures.

Tilt at windmills.definition: Đánh lộn với cối xay gió; Làm việc hão huyền
Tilt at windmills.example: Arguing with him about that old theory is just tilting at windmills.

time flies.definition: Thời gian trôi nhanh như tên bắn, thoắt cái đã trôi qua.
time flies.example: It feels like we just started the semester yesterday—how time flies!
