Time is money.example: Let’s not delay the project any longer. Remember, time is money.

time will tell.definition: Thời gian sẽ trả lời / Thời gian sẽ cho biết kết quả.
time will tell.example: Whether this new investment strategy succeeds, only time will tell.

to make matters worse.definition: Tệ hơn nữa là, lại làm cho tình hình thêm tồi tệ.
to make matters worse.example: Our car broke down in the middle of nowhere, and to make matters worse, it started to rain heavily.

Tongue-in-cheek.definition: Nói đùa, châm biếm nhẹ nhàng.
Tongue-in-cheek.example: His comments about the new policy were clearly tongue-in-cheek.

Too big for one's boots.definition: Kiêu ngạo, hợm hĩnh, tự cao tự đại.
Too big for one's boots.example: Ever since his promotion, John has become too big for his boots.

Too many irons in the fire.definition: Ôm đồm quá nhiều việc cùng lúc.
Too many irons in the fire.example: She has too many irons in the fire and can't focus on any single project.

Top dog.definition: Kẻ cầm đầu, người có quyền lực nhất, người dẫn đầu.
Top dog.example: In the tech industry, she is considered the top dog.

Top-notch.definition: Xuất sắc, đỉnh cao, chất lượng tuyệt hảo
Top-notch.example: The restaurant is known for its top-notch service.

Touch and go.definition: Tình huống bấp bênh, không chắc chắn
Touch and go.example: It was touch and go for a while after the surgery.

Touch base.definition: Liên lạc nhanh, trao đổi ngắn gọn
Touch base.example: Let's touch base next week to finalize the details.

Track record.definition: Bề dày thành tích, lịch sử hoạt động
Track record.example: She has an impressive track record in sales.

Train of thought.example: I lost my train of thought during the presentation.

Train wreck.definition: Thảm họa, tình trạng hỗn loạn
Train wreck.example: The meeting was a complete train wreck; nothing got resolved.

Travel light.definition: Đi du lịch gọn nhẹ, mang ít hành lý
Travel light.example: When we go camping, we always try to travel light.

Treat someone to something.definition: Thiết đãi, khao ai cái gì
Treat someone to something.example: I'll treat you to dinner tonight.

Troubled waters.definition: Tình cảnh khó khăn, rắc rối
Troubled waters.example: The company's financial issues have placed them in troubled waters.

True blue.definition: Vô cùng trung thành, đáng tin cậy
True blue.example: Jane is a true blue friend; you can always count on her.

Tuckered out.example: After the hike, we were all tuckered out and went straight to bed.

Turn a blind eye.definition: Nhắm mắt làm ngơ, lờ đi
Turn a blind eye.example: The manager decided to turn a blind eye to the minor rule-breaking.

Turn a place upside down.example: We had to turn the place upside down to find the missing keys.

Turn over a new leaf.definition: Cải tà quy chính, làm lại cuộc đời, bước sang trang mới
Turn over a new leaf.example: After years of bad habits, he decided to turn over a new leaf and live healthier.

Turn the other cheek.definition: Chìa má kia ra (chấp nhận bị tổn thương mà không trả đũa), nhẫn nhịn
Turn the other cheek.example: When bullied in school, he chose to turn the other cheek rather than fight back.

Turn the tables.example: He thought he could win, but she turned the tables on him.

Turn up the heat.example: The manager turned up the heat on the sales team to reach their quarterly targets.

Twist someone's arm.definition: Thuyết phục ai đó, ép buộc ai đó làm gì
Twist someone's arm.example: I had to twist his arm to get him to join the team.

Two peas in a pod.example: They are two peas in a pod; they do everything together.

Under a cloud.definition: Bị nghi ngờ, bị mang tiếng xấu
Under a cloud.example: Since the scandal, he's been under a cloud at work.

Under someone's thumb.definition: Chịu sự sai khiến, bị ai đó kiểm soát
Under someone's thumb.example: He's completely under his boss's thumb and never makes a decision on his own.

Under the table.definition: Lén lút, bất hợp pháp (đặc biệt là giao dịch)
Under the table.example: He was fired for accepting money under the table.

under the weather.definition: Cảm thấy mệt mỏi, khó ở, hơi ốm.
under the weather.example: I will stay home today because I am feeling a bit under the weather.

Under the wire.example: She turned in her assignment just under the wire before the deadline.

Until the cows come home.example: You can wait until the cows come home, but she's not going to change her mind.

Up a blind alley.definition: Đi vào ngõ cụt, không mang lại kết quả
Up a blind alley.example: We spent months on this project, but in the end, we realized we were up a blind alley.

Up a gum tree.definition: Gặp rắc rối lớn, tiến thoái lưỡng nan
Up a gum tree.example: When the project lost its funding, the whole team felt up a gum tree.

Up for grabs.definition: Có sẵn để ai cũng có thể lấy/giành được
Up for grabs.example: The tickets to the concert are up for grabs, so act fast!

Up in arms.definition: Rất tức giận, phản đối gay gắt
Up in arms.example: The community is up in arms about the proposed development project.

Up in the air.definition: Chưa được quyết định, còn dang dở
Up in the air.example: Our vacation plans are still up in the air because we're waiting for confirmation from the hotel.

Up the creek without a paddle.definition: Lâm vào cảnh khốn cùng, bế tắc
Up the creek without a paddle.example: After losing his job, he felt he was up the creek without a paddle.

Up to snuff.example: His work wasn't up to snuff, so he had to redo it.

up to you.definition: Tùy bạn, do bạn quyết định.
up to you.example: We can eat Italian food or Japanese food tonight—it is completely up to you.

Upset the apple cart.definition: Làm hỏng chuyện, phá hỏng kế hoạch
Upset the apple cart.example: His unexpected resignation upset the apple cart at the company.

Use your loaf.definition: Động não đi, dùng cái đầu đi
Use your loaf.example: Come on, use your loaf! It's not that complicated.

Veg out.definition: Thư giãn hoàn toàn, không làm gì cả
Veg out.example: After a long week at work, I just want to veg out on the couch and watch movies.

Walk in someone's shoes.definition: Đặt mình vào vị trí của người khác
Walk in someone's shoes.example: Before criticizing her, try to walk in her shoes and understand her situation.

Walk on air.definition: Cực kỳ hạnh phúc, vui như ở trên mây
Walk on air.example: After hearing the good news, she was literally walking on air.

Wallflower.definition: Người nhút nhát, người ít giao tiếp (thường ở các bữa tiệc)
Wallflower.example: At every party, she feels like a wallflower, afraid to dance or mingle.

Wash one's hands of something.definition: Rũ bỏ trách nhiệm, phủi tay
Wash one's hands of something.example: After the project became too complicated, she finally said she was washing her hands of it.

Waste not, want not.definition: Ăn tiêu chừng mực thì không lo túng thiếu
Waste not, want not.example: By following the waste not, want not rule, we managed to save a lot of money over the years.

Watch out for.example: Watch out for that car while crossing the street.

Water under the bridge.definition: Chuyện đã qua, không còn quan trọng nữa
Water under the bridge.example: We had our differences in the past, but it's all water under the bridge now.

Watering hole.definition: Quán rượu, nơi tụ tập uống rượu
Watering hole.example: The local pub has become my favorite watering hole.

Wave of the future.example: Electric cars are the wave of the future.

Wear many hats.definition: Đảm nhiệm nhiều vai trò, kiêm nhiệm nhiều việc
Wear many hats.example: In a small company, employees often have to wear many different hats to get things done.

Wear one's heart on one's sleeve.definition: Ruột để ngoài da, bộc lộ rõ cảm xúc ra ngoài
Wear one's heart on one's sleeve.example: John always wears his heart on his sleeve, you can tell when he's upset.

wear the pants.definition: Nắm quyền trong nhà, làm chủ mối quan hệ/gia đình.
wear the pants.example: Everyone knows that his wife wears the pants in their household.

wear your heart on your sleeve.definition: Ruột để ngoài da, bộc lộ tình cảm một cách chân thật và rõ ràng.
wear your heart on your sleeve.example: He always wears his heart on his sleeve, so you never have to guess what he is thinking.

Weasel out of something.definition: Trốn tránh trách nhiệm một cách khôn lỏi
Weasel out of something.example: She tried to weasel out of paying her share of the bill.

Weather the storm.definition: Vượt qua khó khăn, sóng gió
Weather the storm.example: She has weathered many storms in her career and emerged stronger each time.

Well begun is half done.definition: Đầu xuôi đuôi lọt, khởi đầu tốt là đã thành công một nửa
Well begun is half done.example: Remember, well begun is half done, so take your time with initial preparations.

Well-heeled.definition: Giàu có, rủng rỉnh tiền bạc
Well-heeled.example: The banquet was attended by many well-heeled guests.

Wet behind the ears.definition: Trẻ người non dạ, còn non nớt (thiếu kinh nghiệm)
Wet behind the ears.example: He may seem confident, but he's still wet behind the ears when it comes to finance.

Wet blanket.definition: Kẻ phá đám, người làm mất vui
Wet blanket.example: Don't be a wet blanket; join us for the party!

Wet one's whistle.definition: Uống chút gì đó (thường là rượu bia) cho thấm giọng
Wet one's whistle.example: After a long day, he wanted to stop at the bar and wet his whistle.

What are you up to?.definition: Dạo này bạn thế nào? / Bạn đang làm gì đó?
What are you up to?.example: Hey John, what are you up to this weekend?

When it rains, it pours.definition: Họa vô đơn chí, họa không tới một mình
When it rains, it pours.example: First, I got a flat tire, and then my favorite coffee shop closed — when it rains, it pours.

When pigs fly.definition: Chuyện hoang đường, không bao giờ xảy ra (chuyện mặt trời mọc đằng tây)
When pigs fly.example: He said he'd tidy his room, but that will happen when pigs fly.

When push comes to shove.definition: Khi đến bước đường cùng, trong tình huống khẩn cấp
When push comes to shove.example: When push comes to shove, we can always count on Susan to take charge.

When the chips are down.definition: Trong những lúc khó khăn nhất, khi tình hình trở nên nghiêm trọng
When the chips are down.example: When the chips are down, true friends will be there for you.

Where the rubber meets the road.definition: Nơi thử thách thực sự, lúc lý thuyết được đưa vào thực tiễn
Where the rubber meets the road.example: We can plan all we want, but this idea really shows its value where the rubber meets the road.

Where were we?.definition: Chúng ta đang nói đến đâu rồi nhỉ?
Where were we?.example: Sorry for the interruption. Where were we?

White elephant.definition: Sự vật đắt tiền nhưng vô dụng hoặc tốn kém để bảo trì
White elephant.example: The new stadium turned out to be a white elephant; nobody uses it, and the maintenance costs are skyrocketing.

White lie.definition: Lời nói dối vô hại, lời nói dối thiện ý
White lie.example: She told a white lie to spare his feelings.

Whitewash.definition: Che đậy sự thật, tẩy trắng (tội lỗi)
Whitewash.example: The company tried to whitewash the environmental disaster it caused.

Who asked you?.definition: Ai mướn bạn nói? / Ai hỏi bạn đâu?

Who do you think you are?.definition: Bạn nghĩ bạn là ai chứ?
Who do you think you are?.example: Who do you think you are?

wicked.example: Wow, your skateboard tricks are wicked!

Wild and woolly.definition: Hỗn loạn, hoang dã và thiếu kiểm soát
Wild and woolly.example: The party last night was wild and woolly; no one knew what would happen next.

window shopping.definition: Đi ngắm đồ qua tủ kính (đi dạo xem đồ chứ không mua).
window shopping.example: We spent a relaxing Sunday afternoon window shopping along the boulevard.

Wine and dine.definition: Thiết đãi nồng hậu, chiêu đãi thịnh soạn
Wine and dine.example: He wined and dined his prospective clients at the fancy restaurant.

Wing it.definition: Tùy cơ ứng biến, làm mà không có sự chuẩn bị trước
Wing it.example: I forgot my speech notes, so I had to wing it during the presentation.

With bated breath.definition: Nín thở chờ đợi, hồi hộp mong đợi
With bated breath.example: Everyone in the room was listening with bated breath as the announcement was made.

With bells on.definition: Với thái độ vô cùng háo hức và nhiệt tình
With bells on.example: Count me in for the trip; I'll be there with bells on.

With flying colors.definition: Một cách xuất sắc, thành công mỹ mãn
With flying colors.example: She passed the exam with flying colors.

Work against the clock.definition: Chạy đua với thời gian, làm việc khẩn trương
Work against the clock.example: We're working against the clock to complete the project before the deadline.

Worth one's salt.definition: Đáng đồng tiền bát gạo, có năng lực xứng đáng với vị trí
Worth one's salt.example: Any chef worth their salt knows how to prepare a perfect steak.

Wouldn't be caught dead.definition: Thà chết còn hơn, nhất quyết không bao giờ làm
Wouldn't be caught dead.example: He wouldn't be caught dead wearing those old-fashioned shoes.

Wouldn't hurt a fly.definition: Rất hiền lành, hiền như cục đất (không dám làm hại một con ruồi)
Wouldn't hurt a fly.example: John is the sweetest person; he wouldn't hurt a fly.

Wouldn't touch it with a ten-foot pole.definition: Tránh xa ra, có cho thêm tiền cũng không dám đụng vào
Wouldn't touch it with a ten-foot pole.example: That investment seems too risky; I wouldn't touch it with a ten-foot pole.

Wrap one's head around something.definition: Cố gắng hiểu hoặc chấp nhận một điều gì đó phức tạp
Wrap one's head around something.example: It took him a while to wrap his head around the new software program.

wrap your head around.definition: Hiểu thấu, tiêu hóa hay chấp nhận một khái niệm phức tạp.
wrap your head around.example: Quantum physics is a fascinating subject, but it takes time to wrap your head around its principles.

X marks the spot.definition: Chính là chỗ này, đúng ngay điểm này
X marks the spot.example: The treasure map shows that X marks the spot where the gold is buried.

You bet.definition: Chắc chắn rồi, tất nhiên rồi
You bet.example: Will you help me with this project? You bet!

You can bet your boots.definition: Dám cá là, chắc chắn một trăm phần trăm
You can bet your boots.example: When he says he'll finish the project by Friday, you can bet your boots he will.

You can bet your bottom dollar.definition: Đảm bảo luôn, dám cá bằng đồng xu cuối cùng
You can bet your bottom dollar.example: You can bet your bottom dollar that she'll be at the party tonight.

You can lead a horse to water, but you c.definition: Có thể mang lại cơ hội cho ai đó nhưng không thể ép họ đón nhận (không thể ép ai làm việc họ không muốn)
You can lead a horse to water, but you c.example: I gave her all the tools to succeed, but she still failed. You can lead a horse to water, but you can't make him drink.

You can say that again.definition: Bạn nói quá chuẩn, hoàn toàn đồng ý
You can say that again.example: The weather is beautiful today; you can say that again.

You can't have your cake and eat it too.definition: Được cái này mất cái kia, không thể bắt cá hai tay
You can't have your cake and eat it too.example: He wants the promotion without working hard. Well, you can't have your cake and eat it too.

You can't judge a book by its cover.definition: Đừng trông mặt mà bắt hình dong
You can't judge a book by its cover.example: The old house may look shabby, but you can't judge a book by its cover. It is beautifully decorated inside.

You can't make an omelet without breakin.definition: Muốn đạt được thành tựu thì phải chịu đánh đổi
You can't make an omelet without breakin.example: Implementing new policies will face some resistance, but you can't make an omelet without breaking some eggs.

You can't squeeze blood out of a turnip.definition: Vắt cổ chày ra nước (không thể đòi hỏi thứ mà người ta không có)
You can't squeeze blood out of a turnip.example: Trying to get a confession out of him is like trying to squeeze blood out of a turnip.

You can't take it with you.definition: Sống để dạ chết mang đi, của cải không thể mang theo khi chết
You can't take it with you.example: He amassed a great fortune, but in the end, you can't take it with you.

You can't teach an old dog new tricks.definition: Tre già khó uốn, khó mà thay đổi thói quen của người già
You can't teach an old dog new tricks.example: My grandfather refuses to use a smartphone; you know what they say, you can't teach an old dog new tricks.

You catch more flies with honey than wit.definition: Lời nói ngọt ngào dễ lọt tai hơn, lạt mềm buộc chặt
You catch more flies with honey than wit.example: Try to be nicer when asking for help. You catch more flies with honey than with vinegar.

You're telling me.definition: Khỏi phải nói, tôi biết quá đi chứ
You're telling me.example: He says he is busy, but you're telling me.

You've sold me.definition: Thuyết phục được tôi rồi đấy
You've sold me.example: Okay, you've sold me on the idea of taking a weekend trip.

your guess is as good as mine.definition: Tôi cũng không biết; tôi cũng mờ mịt như bạn
your guess is as good as mine.example: When will the project be finished? Your guess is as good as mine.

zero tolerance.definition: Không khoan nhượng; chính sách xử lý nghiêm ngặt mọi vi phạm
zero tolerance.example: The school has a zero tolerance policy for bullying.

zip it.definition: Im đi; ngậm miệng lại; đừng nói nữa
zip it.example: He was about to reveal the surprise, but she quickly told him to zip it.
